Let me draft the implementation plan.","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":true,"Summary":"Complete implementation plan for a Tiffin Service application built with Spring Boot 3 backend and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend. dashboard.","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Tiffin Service — Full-Stack Implementation Plan\n\nA home-style tiffin (lunch delivery) service backend built with **Spring Boot 3 + H2 (dev) database**, plus a **vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend** served as static resources.\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n| Layer | Technology |\n|-------|-----------|\n| Backend | Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x |\n| Security | Spring Security + JWT |\n| Database | H2 (embedded, file-persisted) — swap to PostgreSQL/MySQL later |\n| ORM | Spring Data JPA (Hibernate) |\n| API Docs | SpringDoc OpenAPI (Swagger UI) |\n| Frontend | Vanilla HTML + CSS + JS (served from `src/main/resources/static/`) |\n| Build | Maven |\n\n---\n\n## Database Schema\n\n```mermaid\nerDiagram\n    USERS {\n        bigint id PK\n        varchar name\n        varchar phone UK\n        varchar email UK\n        varchar password_hash\n        varchar role \"OWNER / CUSTOMER\"\n        timestamp created_at\n    }\n    SUBSCRIPTION {\n        bigint id PK\n        bigint customer_id FK\n        varchar plan_name \"BASIC / STANDARD / PREMIUM\"\n        decimal plan_price \"monthly price\"\n        date start_date\n        date end_date\n        varchar status \"ACTIVE / CANCELLED\"\n        timestamp created_at\n    }\n    PAUSE_PERIOD {\n        bigint id PK\n        bigint subscription_id FK\n        date pause_date\n        date resume_date \"null = still paused\"\n        varchar reason\n        timestamp created_at\n    }\n    INVOICE {\n        bigint id PK\n        bigint subscription_id FK\n        int billing_month\n        int billing_year\n        int total_weekdays\n        int paused_days\n        int delivered_days\n        decimal plan_price\n        decimal billed_amount\n        timestamp generated_at\n    }\n    USERS ||--o{ SUBSCRIPTION : subscribes\n    SUBSCRIPTION ||--o{ PAUSE_PERIOD : has\n    SUBSCRIPTION ||--o{ INVOICE : generates\n```\n\n### Pro-Rating Logic\n\n```\ntotalWeekdays   = count weekdays in the billing month\npausedDays      = count weekdays that fall inside any pause period\ndeliveredDays   = totalWeekdays − pausedDays\ndailyRate       = planPrice / totalWeekdays\nbilledAmount    = dailyRate × deliveredDays\n```\n\n---\n\n## REST API Design\n\n### Auth (`/api/auth`)\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| POST | `/register` | Register a new user (owner or customer) |\n| POST | `/login` | Login, returns JWT token |\n\n### Customers (`/api/customers`) — Owner-only\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| GET | `/` | List all customers (paginated, sorted) |\n| GET | `/search?phone=...` | Search customer by phone |\n| GET | `/{id}` | Get customer details |\n\n### Subscriptions (`/api/subscriptions`)\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| POST | `/` | Create a new subscription for a customer |\n| GET | `/{id}` | Get subscription details |\n| GET | `/customer/{customerId}` | Get subscriptions for a customer |\n| PUT | `/{id}/cancel` | Cancel a subscription |\n\n### Pause/Resume (`/api/subscriptions/{subId}/pauses`)\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| POST | `/pause` | Pause delivery (set pause_date = today) |\n| PUT | `/resume` | Resume delivery (set resume_date = today) |\n| GET | `/` | List all pause periods for a subscription |\n\n### Billing (`/api/billing`)\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| POST | `/generate?month=9&year=2026` | Generate invoices for all active subs |\n| GET | `/invoice/{id}` | Get a single invoice |\n| GET | `/customer/{customerId}` | Get all invoices for a customer (paginated) |\n| GET | `/subscription/{subId}` | Get invoices for a subscription |\n\n### Dashboard (`/api/dashboard`) — Owner-only\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description |\n|--------|----------|-------------|\n| GET | `/stats` | Active/paused/total customers, revenue |\n\n---\n\n## Frontend Pages\n\nAll served as static files from Spring Boot.\n\n| Page | Description |\n|------|-------------|\n| **Landing** (`index.html`) | Product landing page — what it is, features, audience, future roadmap |\n| **Login/Register** (`login.html`) | Auth forms |\n| **Dashboard** (`dashboard.html`) | Owner view — stats, customer list, search, pause/resume, billing |\n\n---\n\n## Project Structure\n\n```\ntiffin-service/\n├── pom.xml\n├── src/main/java/com/tiffin/\n│   ├── TiffinServiceApplication.java\n│   ├── config/\n│   │   ├── SecurityConfig.java\n│   │   └── JwtUtil.java\n│   ├── controller/\n│   │   ├── AuthController.java\n│   │   ├── CustomerController.java\n│   │   ├── SubscriptionController.java\n│   │   ├── PauseController.java\n│   │   ├── BillingController.java\n│   │   └── DashboardController.java\n│   ├── dto/\n│   │   ├── LoginRequest.java / LoginResponse.java\n│   │   ├── RegisterRequest.java\n│   │   ├── SubscriptionRequest.java\n│   │   ├── PauseRequest.java\n│   │   └── InvoiceResponse.java\n│   ├── entity/\n│   │   ├── User.java\n│   │   ├── Subscription.java\n│   │   ├── PausePeriod.java\n│   │   └── Invoice.java\n│   ├── repository/\n│   │   ├── UserRepository.java\n│   │   ├── SubscriptionRepository.java\n│   │   ├── PausePeriodRepository.java\n│   │   └── InvoiceRepository.java\n│   ├── service/\n│   │   ├── AuthService.java\n│   │   ├── CustomerService.java\n│   │   ├── SubscriptionService.java\n│   │   ├── PauseService.java\n│   │   ├── BillingService.java\n│   │   └── DashboardService.java\n│   ├── security/\n│   │   ├── JwtAuthFilter.java\n│   │   └── CustomUserDetailsService.java\n│   └── exception/\n│       ├── GlobalExceptionHandler.java\n│       └── ResourceNotFoundException.java\n├── src/main/resources/\n│   ├── application.properties\n│   ├── data.sql (seed data)\n│   └── static/\n│       ├── index.html (landing page)\n│       ├── login.html\n│       ├── dashboard.html\n│       ├── css/style.css\n│       └── js/\n│           ├── auth.js\n│           └── dashboard.js\n└── src/test/java/com/tiffin/\n    └── ...\n```\n\n---\n\n## Proposed Changes\n\n### Backend Core\n\n#### [NEW] `pom.xml` — Maven dependencies\nSpring Boot Starter Web, Data JPA, Security, Validation, H2, JJWT, SpringDoc OpenAPI.\n\n#### [NEW] `application.properties` — DB config, JWT secret, server port\nH2 file-persisted database, console enabled, JPA auto DDL.\n\n#### [NEW] `data.sql` — Seed data\nCreates an owner account and a few sample customers with subscriptions.\n\n---\n\n### Entity Layer\n\n#### [NEW] `User.java` — User entity with roles (OWNER/CUSTOMER)\n#### [NEW] `Subscription.java` — Monthly subscription with plan and status\n#### [NEW] `PausePeriod.java` — Tracks pause/resume date ranges\n#### [NEW] `Invoice.java` — Generated monthly bills with pro-rating breakdown\n\n---\n\n### Repository Layer\n\n#### [NEW] `UserRepository.java` — Phone/email lookup, search by phone pattern\n#### [NEW] `SubscriptionRepository.java` — Find by customer, find active\n#### [NEW] `PausePeriodRepository.java` — Find open pauses, find by date range\n#### [NEW] `InvoiceRepository.java` — Find by customer/subscription, month/year\n\n---\n\n### Service Layer\n\n#### [NEW] `AuthService.java` — Register/login with password hashing + JWT\n#### [NEW] `CustomerService.java` — Customer CRUD, phone search, pagination\n#### [NEW] `SubscriptionService.java` — Create/cancel subscriptions\n#### [NEW] `PauseService.java` — Pause/resume logic with overlap validation\n#### [NEW] `BillingService.java` — **Core billing logic** — weekday counting, pause-day calculation, pro-rated amount\n#### [NEW] `DashboardService.java` — Aggregate stats (active/paused/total)\n\n---\n\n### Controller Layer (REST APIs)\n\n#### [NEW] `AuthController.java` — POST /register, POST /login\n#### [NEW] `CustomerController.java` — GET customers with pagination/sorting/search\n#### [NEW] `SubscriptionController.java` — CRUD for subscriptions\n#### [NEW] `PauseController.java` — POST pause, PUT resume\n#### [NEW] `BillingController.java` — Generate and retrieve invoices\n#### [NEW] `DashboardController.java` — GET stats\n\n---\n\n### Security\n\n#### [NEW] `SecurityConfig.java` — Spring Security config, JWT filter chain\n#### [NEW] `JwtUtil.java` — JWT token generation and validation\n#### [NEW] `JwtAuthFilter.java` — OncePerRequestFilter for JWT auth\n#### [NEW] `CustomUserDetailsService.java` — Loads user by email for Spring Security\n\n---\n\n### Frontend (Static)\n\n#### [NEW] `index.html` — Landing page (product info, features, audience, roadmap)\n#### [NEW] `login.html` — Login and registration forms\n#### [NEW] `dashboard.html` — Owner dashboard with customer management, billing\n#### [NEW] `css/style.css` — Premium dark-theme styling\n#### [NEW] `js/auth.js` — Login/register API calls, JWT storage\n#### [NEW] `js/dashboard.js` — Dashboard API calls, pagination, search, billing\n\n---\n\n## Verification Plan\n\n### Automated\n```bash\nmvn clean compile    # Compiles without errors\nmvn spring-boot:run  # App starts, H2 console accessible at /h2-console\n```\n\n### Manual Verification\n1. Register an owner and a customer via API\n2. Create a subscription\n3. Pause and resume delivery\n4. Generate a monthly invoice — verify pro-rated amount\n5. Search customer by phone\n6. Test pagination/sorting on customer list\n7. Verify landing page renders at `/`\n8. Verify dashboard at `/dashboard.html`\n","Description":"Full implementation plan for the Tiffin Service application","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\HP\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e\\implementation_plan.md","toolAction":"Creating implementation plan","toolSummary":"Implementation plan artifact"}}]}

}\n    public void setCreatedAt(LocalDateTime createdAt) { this.createdAt = createdAt; }\n}\n","Description":"Subscription entity with plan tiers, pricing, and ACTIVE/PAUSED/CANCELLED status","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\entity\\Subscription.java","toolAction":"Creating Subscription entity","toolSummary":"Subscription entity"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.entity;\n\nimport jakarta.persistence.*;\nimport jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.time.LocalDateTime;\n\n@Entity\n@Table(name = \"pause_periods\")\npublic class PausePeriod {\n\n    @Id\n    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)\n    private Long id;\n\n    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)\n    @JoinColumn(name = \"subscription_id\", nullable = false)\n    private Subscription subscription;\n\n    @NotNull\n    @Column(name = \"pause_date\", nullable = false)\n    private LocalDate pauseDate;\n\n    @Column(name = \"resume_date\")\n    private LocalDate resumeDate; // null means still paused\n\n    private String reason;\n\n    @Column(name = \"created_at\", nullable = false, updatable = false)\n    private LocalDateTime createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();\n\n    public PausePeriod() {}\n\n    public PausePeriod(Subscription subscription, LocalDate pauseDate, String reason) {\n        this.subscription = subscription;\n        this.pauseDate = pauseDate;\n        this.reason = reason;\n    }\n\n    /** Returns true if delivery is paused on the given date. */\n    public boolean coversDate(LocalDate date) {\n        if (date.isBefore(pauseDate)) return false;\n        if (resumeDate == null) return true; // still paused\n        return !date.isAfter(resumeDate.minusDays(1)); // resume date = first day back\n    }\n\n    // ── Getters & Setters ──\n\n    public Long getId() { return id; }\n    public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }\n    public void setPauseDate(LocalDate pauseDate) { this.pauseDate = pauseDate; }\n\n    public LocalDate getResumeDate() { return resumeDate; }\n    public void setResumeDate(LocalDate resumeDate) { this.resumeDate = resumeDate; }\n\n    public String getReason() { return reason; }\n    public void setReason(String reason) { this.reason = reason; }\n\n    public LocalDateTime getCreatedAt() { return createdAt; }\n    public void setCreatedAt(LocalDateTime createdAt) { this.createdAt = createdAt; Security:","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.config;\n\nimport io.jsonwebtoken.*;\nimport io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport javax.crypto.SecretKey;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.Date;\n\n@Component\npublic class JwtUtil {\n\n    private final SecretKey key;\n    private final long expirationMs;\n\n    public JwtUtil(\n            @Value(\"${app.jwt.secret}\") String secret,\n            @Value(\"${app.jwt.expiration-ms}\") long expirationMs) {\n        this.key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n        this.expirationMs = expirationMs;\n    }\n\n    public String generateToken(String email, String role) {\n        return Jwts.builder()\n                .subject(email)\n                .claim(\"role\", role)\n                .issuedAt(new Date())\n                .expiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expirationMs))\n                .signWith(key)\n                .compact();\n    }\n\n    public String getEmailFromToken(String token) {\n        return getClaims(token).getPayload().getSubject();\n    }\n\n    public String getRoleFromToken(String token) {\n        return getClaims(token).getPayload().get(\"role\", String.class);\n    }\n\n    public boolean validateToken(String token) {\n        try {\n            getClaims(token);\n            return true;\n        } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException e) {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Jws<Claims> getClaims(String token) {\n        return Jwts.parser()\n                .verifyWith(key)\n                .build()\n                .parseSignedClaims(token);\n    }\n}\n","Description":"JWT utility — token generation, validation, and claim extraction using JJWT 0.12","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\config\\JwtUtil.java","toolAction":"Creating JwtUtil","toolSummary":"JWT utility"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.security;\n\nimport com.tiffin.entity.User;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.*;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\n@Service\npublic class CustomUserDetailsService implements UserDetailsService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n\n    public CustomUserDetailsService(UserRepository userRepository) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String email) throws UsernameNotFoundException {\n        User user = userRepository.findByEmail(email)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new UsernameNotFoundException(\"User not found: \" + email));\n\n        return new org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User(\n                user.getEmail(),\n                user.getPassword(),\n                List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority(\"ROLE_\" + user.getRole().name()))\n        );\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Custom UserDetailsService that loads users by email for Spring Security","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\security\\CustomUserDetailsService.java","toolAction":"Creating UserDetailsService","toolSummary":"User details service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.security;\n\nimport com.tiffin.config.JwtUtil;\nimport jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;\nimport jakarta.servlet.ServletException;\nimport jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;\nimport jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;\nimport org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;\nimport org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\nimport org.springframework.util.StringUtils;\nimport org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\n\n@Component\npublic class JwtAuthFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {\n\n    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;\n    private final CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService;\n\n    public JwtAuthFilter(JwtUtil jwtUtil, CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService) {\n        this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;\n        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    protected void doFilterInternal(HttpServletRequest request,\n                                    HttpServletResponse response,\n                                    FilterChain filterChain) throws ServletException, IOException {\n        String token = extractToken(request);\n\n        if (token != null && jwtUtil.validateToken(token)) {\n            String email = jwtUtil.getEmailFromToken(token);\n            UserDetails userDetails = userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(email);\n\n            UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken auth =\n                    new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(userDetails, null, userDetails.getAuthorities());\n            auth.setDetails(new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request));\n\n            SecurityContextHolder.getContext().setAuthentication(auth);\n        }\n\n        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);\n    }\n\n    private String extractToken(HttpServletRequest request) {\n        String header = request.getHeader(\"Authorization\");\n        if (StringUtils.hasText(header) && header.startsWith(\"Bearer \")) {\n            return header.substring(7);\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n}\n","Description":"JWT authentication filter — extracts and validates Bearer token on each filter"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.config;\n\nimport com.tiffin.security.JwtAuthFilter;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;\nimport org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;\nimport org.springframework.security.config.annotation.authentication.configuration.AuthenticationConfiguration;\nimport org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;\nimport org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;\nimport org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;\nimport org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;\nimport org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;\nimport org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;\n\n@Configuration\n@EnableWebSecurity\n@EnableMethodSecurity\npublic class SecurityConfig {\n\n    private final JwtAuthFilter jwtAuthFilter;\n\n    public SecurityConfig(JwtAuthFilter jwtAuthFilter) {\n        this.jwtAuthFilter = jwtAuthFilter;\n    }\n\n    @Bean\n    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {\n        http\n            .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())\n            .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))\n            .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth\n                // Public endpoints\n                .requestMatchers(\"/\", \"/index.html\", \"/login.html\", \"/dashboard.html\").permitAll()\n                .requestMatchers(\"/css/**\", \"/js/**\", \"/images/**\", \"/favicon.ico\").permitAll()\n                .requestMatchers(\"/api/auth/**\").permitAll()\n                .requestMatchers(\"/h2-console/**\").permitAll()\n                .requestMatchers(\"/swagger-ui/**\", \"/v3/api-docs/**\", \"/swagger-ui.html\").permitAll()\n                // All other API endpoints require authentication\n                .requestMatchers(\"/api/**\").authenticated()\n                .anyRequest().permitAll()\n            )\n            .headers(headers -> headers.frameOptions(fo -> fo.sameOrigin())) // H2 console\n            .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);\n\n        return http.build();\n    }\n\n    @Bean\n    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {\n        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();\n    }\n\n    @Bean\n    public AuthenticationManager authenticationManager(AuthenticationConfiguration config) throws Exception {\n        return config.getAuthenticationManager();\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Spring Security config — stateless JWT, public auth/static endpoints, all /api/** require auth","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\config\\SecurityConfig.java","toolAction":"Creating SecurityConfig","toolSummary":"Security config"}}]}

exception","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\exception\\ResourceNotFoundException.java","toolAction":"Creating exception class","toolSummary":"ResourceNotFound exception"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.exception;\n\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.validation.FieldError;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDateTime;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n@RestControllerAdvice\npublic class GlobalExceptionHandler {\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(ResourceNotFoundException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleNotFound(ResourceNotFoundException ex) {\n        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleBadRequest(IllegalArgumentException ex) {\n        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ex.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalStateException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleConflict(IllegalStateException ex) {\n        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ex.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex) {\n        Map<String, String> errors = new HashMap<>();\n        for (FieldError error : ex.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors()) {\n            errors.put(error.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage());\n        }\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", LocalDateTime.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"status\", HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value());\n        body.put(\"error\", \"Validation Failed\");\n        body.put(\"details\", errors);\n        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(body);\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleGeneral(Exception ex) {\n        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, \"An unexpected error occurred\");\n    }\n\n    private ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> buildResponse(HttpStatus status, String message) {\n        Map<String, Object> body = new HashMap<>();\n        body.put(\"timestamp\", LocalDateTime.now().toString());\n        body.put(\"status\", status.value());\n        body.put(\"error\", status.getReasonPhrase());\n        body.put(\"message\", message);\n        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body);\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Global exception handler for validation, not-found, conflict, and generic errors","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\exception\\GlobalExceptionHandler.java","toolAction":"Creating exception handler","toolSummary":"Exception handler"}}]}

logic:","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.config.JwtUtil;\nimport com.tiffin.dto.LoginRequest;\nimport com.tiffin.dto.LoginResponse;\nimport com.tiffin.dto.RegisterRequest;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.User;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;\nimport org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;\nimport org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\n@Service\npublic class AuthService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;\n    private final JwtUtil jwtUtil;\n    private final AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;\n\n    public AuthService(UserRepository userRepository,\n                       PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,\n                       JwtUtil jwtUtil,\n                       AuthenticationManager authenticationManager) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;\n        this.jwtUtil = jwtUtil;\n        this.authenticationManager = authenticationManager;\n    }\n\n    public User register(RegisterRequest request) {\n        if (userRepository.existsByEmail(request.getEmail())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Email already registered: \" + request.getEmail());\n        }\n        if (userRepository.existsByPhone(request.getPhone())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Phone already registered: \" + request.getPhone());\n        }\n\n        User user = new User();\n        user.setName(request.getName());\n        user.setPhone(request.getPhone());\n        user.setEmail(request.getEmail());\n        user.setPassword(passwordEncoder.encode(request.getPassword()));\n\n        if (request.getRole() != null && request.getRole().equalsIgnoreCase(\"OWNER\")) {\n            user.setRole(User.Role.OWNER);\n        } else {\n            user.setRole(User.Role.CUSTOMER);\n        }\n\n        return userRepository.save(user);\n    }\n\n    public LoginResponse login(LoginRequest request) {\n        authenticationManager.authenticate(\n                new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(request.getEmail(), request.getPassword()));\n\n        User user = userRepository.findByEmail(request.getEmail())\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid credentials\"));\n\n        String token = jwtUtil.generateToken(user.getEmail(), user.getRole().name());\n\n        return new LoginResponse(token, user.getName(), user.getEmail(),\n                user.getRole().name(), user.getId());\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Auth service — registration with duplicate checks and BCrypt, login with JWT generation","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\AuthService.java","toolAction":"Creating AuthService","toolSummary":"Auth service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.entity.User;\nimport com.tiffin.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Page;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\n@Service\npublic class CustomerService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n\n    public CustomerService(UserRepository userRepository) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n    }\n\n    public Page<User> getAllCustomers(Pageable pageable) {\n        return userRepository.findByRole(User.Role.CUSTOMER, pageable);\n    }\n\n    public Page<User> searchCustomers(String query, Pageable pageable) {\n        return userRepository.findByRoleAndPhoneContainingOrRoleAndNameContainingIgnoreCase(\n                User.Role.CUSTOMER, query,\n                User.Role.CUSTOMER, query,\n                pageable);\n    }\n\n    public User getCustomerById(Long id) {\n        User user = userRepository.findById(id)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Customer not found: \" + id));\n        if (user.getRole() != User.Role.CUSTOMER) {\n            throw new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Customer not found: \" + id);\n        }\n        return user;\n    }\n\n    public User getCustomerByPhone(String phone) {\n        return userRepository.findByPhone(phone)\n                .filter(u -> u.getRole() == User.Role.CUSTOMER)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Customer not found with phone: \" + phone));\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Customer service — paginated listing, phone/name search, single lookups","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\CustomerService.java","toolAction":"Creating CustomerService","toolSummary":"Customer service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.dto.SubscriptionRequest;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Subscription;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.User;\nimport com.tiffin.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.SubscriptionRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Page;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n@Service\npublic class SubscriptionService {\n\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n\n    public SubscriptionService(SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository,\n                               UserRepository userRepository) {\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n    }\n\n    public Subscription createSubscription(SubscriptionRequest request) {\n        User customer = userRepository.findById(request.getCustomerId())\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Customer not found: \" + request.getCustomerId()));\n\n        // Check for existing active subscription\n        List<Subscription> active = subscriptionRepository\n                .findByCustomerIdAndStatus(customer.getId(), Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        if (!active.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Customer already has an active subscription\");\n        }\n\n        Subscription sub = new Subscription();\n        sub.setCustomer(customer);\n        sub.setStartDate(LocalDate.now());\n\n        // Plan name\n        Subscription.PlanName plan = Subscription.PlanName.BASIC;\n        if (request.getPlanName() != null) {\n            plan = Subscription.PlanName.valueOf(request.getPlanName().toUpperCase());\n        }\n        sub.setPlanName(plan);\n\n        // Plan price — use provided or default\n        if (request.getPlanPrice() != null) {\n            sub.setPlanPrice(request.getPlanPrice());\n        } else {\n            sub.setPlanPrice(getDefaultPrice(plan));\n        }\n\n        sub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        return subscriptionRepository.save(sub);\n    }\n\n    public Subscription getSubscription(Long id) {\n        return subscriptionRepository.findById(id)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Subscription not found: \" + id));\n    }\n\n    public List<Subscription> getByCustomer(Long customerId) {\n        return subscriptionRepository.findByCustomerId(customerId);\n    }\n\n    public Page<Subscription> getByCustomerPaged(Long customerId, Pageable pageable) {\n        return subscriptionRepository.findByCustomerId(customerId, pageable);\n    }\n\n    public Subscription cancelSubscription(Long id) {\n        Subscription sub = getSubscription(id);\n        if (sub.getStatus() == Subscription.Status.CANCELLED) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Subscription is already cancelled\");\n        }\n        sub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.CANCELLED);\n        sub.setEndDate(LocalDate.now());\n        return subscriptionRepository.save(sub);\n    }\n\n    private BigDecimal getDefaultPrice(Subscription.PlanName plan) {\n        return switch (plan) {\n            case BASIC -> new BigDecimal(\"2000.00\");\n            case STANDARD -> new BigDecimal(\"3000.00\");\n            case PREMIUM -> new BigDecimal(\"4500.00\");\n        };\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Subscription service — create with duplicate check, cancel, default plan pricing","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\SubscriptionService.java","toolAction":"Creating SubscriptionService","toolSummary":"Subscription service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.entity.PausePeriod;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Subscription;\nimport com.tiffin.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.PausePeriodRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.SubscriptionRepository;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n@Service\npublic class PauseService {\n\n    private final PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository;\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n\n    public PauseService(PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository,\n                        SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository) {\n        this.pauseRepository = pauseRepository;\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public PausePeriod pauseSubscription(Long subscriptionId, String reason) {\n        Subscription sub = subscriptionRepository.findById(subscriptionId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Subscription not found: \" + subscriptionId));\n\n        if (sub.getStatus() == Subscription.Status.CANCELLED) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot pause a cancelled subscription\");\n        }\n\n        // Check if already paused\n        if (pauseRepository.findBySubscriptionIdAndResumeDateIsNull(subscriptionId).isPresent()) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Subscription is already paused\");\n        }\n\n        PausePeriod pause = new PausePeriod(sub, LocalDate.now(), reason);\n        sub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.PAUSED);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub);\n\n        return pauseRepository.save(pause);\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public PausePeriod resumeSubscription(Long subscriptionId) {\n        Subscription sub = subscriptionRepository.findById(subscriptionId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Subscription not found: \" + subscriptionId));\n\n        PausePeriod pause = pauseRepository.findBySubscriptionIdAndResumeDateIsNull(subscriptionId)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalStateException(\"Subscription is not currently paused\"));\n\n        pause.setResumeDate(LocalDate.now());\n        sub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub);\n        return pauseRepository.save(pause);\n    }\n\n    public List<PausePeriod> getPausePeriods(Long subscriptionId) {\n        return pauseRepository.findBySubscriptionId(subscriptionId);\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Pause service — pause/resume with state validation and subscription status sync","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\PauseService.java","toolAction":"Creating PauseService","toolSummary":"Pause service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.dto.InvoiceResponse;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Invoice;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.PausePeriod;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Subscription;\nimport com.tiffin.exception.ResourceNotFoundException;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.InvoiceRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.PausePeriodRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.SubscriptionRepository;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Page;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.math.RoundingMode;\nimport java.time.DayOfWeek;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.time.YearMonth;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Optional;\n\n@Service\npublic class BillingService {\n\n    private final InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository;\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n    private final PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository;\n\n    public BillingService(InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository,\n                          SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository,\n                          PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository) {\n        this.invoiceRepository = invoiceRepository;\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n        this.pauseRepository = pauseRepository;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Generate invoices for all active/paused subscriptions for a given month.\n     * Skips subscriptions that already have an invoice for that period.\n     */\n    @Transactional\n    public List<InvoiceResponse> generateInvoices(int month, int year) {\n        List<Subscription> subs = subscriptionRepository.findAllActiveOrPaused();\n        List<InvoiceResponse> results = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        YearMonth ym = YearMonth.of(year, month);\n        LocalDate monthStart = ym.atDay(1);\n        LocalDate monthEnd = ym.atEndOfMonth();\n\n        for (Subscription sub : subs) {\n            // Skip if invoice already exists\n            Optional<Invoice> existing = invoiceRepository\n                    .findBySubscriptionIdAndBillingMonthAndBillingYear(sub.getId(), month, year);\n            if (existing.isPresent()) {\n                results.add(toResponse(existing.get()));\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Skip if subscription started after this month\n            if (sub.getStartDate().isAfter(monthEnd)) continue;\n\n            // Calculate billing\n            int totalWeekdays = countWeekdays(monthStart, monthEnd);\n\n            // Adjust start if subscription started mid-month\n            LocalDate effectiveStart = sub.getStartDate().isAfter(monthStart) ? sub.getStartDate() : monthStart;\n            // Adjust end if subscription was cancelled mid-month\n            LocalDate effectiveEnd = (sub.getEndDate() != null && sub.getEndDate().isBefore(monthEnd))\n                    ? sub.getEndDate() : monthEnd;\n\n            int effectiveWeekdays = countWeekdays(effectiveStart, effectiveEnd);\n\n            // Count paused weekdays\n            List<PausePeriod> pauses = pauseRepository.findOverlappingPauses(sub.getId(), monthStart, monthEnd);\n            int pausedDays = countPausedWeekdays(pauses, effectiveStart, effectiveEnd);\n\n            int deliveredDays = effectiveWeekdays - pausedDays;\n            if (deliveredDays < 0) deliveredDays = 0;\n\n            // Pro-rate: dailyRate = planPrice / totalWeekdays, billedAmount = dailyRate × deliveredDays\n            BigDecimal planPrice = sub.getPlanPrice();\n            BigDecimal dailyRate = totalWeekdays > 0\n                    ? planPrice.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(totalWeekdays), 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)\n                    : BigDecimal.ZERO;\n            BigDecimal billedAmount = dailyRate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(deliveredDays))\n                    .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);\n\n            Invoice invoice = new Invoice();\n            invoice.setSubscription(sub);\n            invoice.setBillingMonth(month);\n            invoice.setBillingYear(year);\n            invoice.setTotalWeekdays(totalWeekdays);\n            invoice.setPausedDays(pausedDays);\n            invoice.setDeliveredDays(deliveredDays);\n            invoice.setPlanPrice(planPrice);\n            invoice.setBilledAmount(billedAmount);\n\n            invoiceRepository.save(invoice);\n            results.add(toResponse(invoice));\n        }\n\n        return results;\n    }\n\n    public InvoiceResponse getInvoice(Long id) {\n        Invoice inv = invoiceRepository.findById(id)\n                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Invoice not found: \" + id));\n        return toResponse(inv);\n    }\n\n    public Page<InvoiceResponse> getInvoicesByCustomer(Long customerId, Pageable pageable) {\n        return invoiceRepository.findByCustomerId(customerId, pageable).map(this::toResponse);\n    }\n\n    public Page<InvoiceResponse> getInvoicesBySubscription(Long subId, Pageable pageable) {\n        return invoiceRepository.findBySubscriptionId(subId, pageable).map(this::toResponse);\n    }\n\n    // ── Helpers ──\n\n    /** Count weekdays (Mon–Fri) between start and end, inclusive. */\n    private int countWeekdays(LocalDate start, LocalDate end) {\n        int count = 0;\n        LocalDate date = start;\n        while (!date.isAfter(end)) {\n            DayOfWeek dow = date.getDayOfWeek();\n            if (dow != DayOfWeek.SATURDAY && dow != DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {\n                count++;\n            }\n            date = date.plusDays(1);\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n\n    /** Count weekdays that fall within any pause period, clamped to effective range. */\n    private int countPausedWeekdays(List<PausePeriod> pauses, LocalDate rangeStart, LocalDate rangeEnd) {\n        int count = 0;\n        LocalDate date = rangeStart;\n        while (!date.isAfter(rangeEnd)) {\n            DayOfWeek dow = date.getDayOfWeek();\n            if (dow != DayOfWeek.SATURDAY && dow != DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) {\n                for (PausePeriod pause : pauses) {\n                    if (pause.coversDate(date)) {\n                        count++;\n                        break; // don't double-count\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            date = date.plusDays(1);\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n\n    private InvoiceResponse toResponse(Invoice inv) {\n        InvoiceResponse r = new InvoiceResponse();\n        r.setId(inv.getId());\n        r.setSubscriptionId(inv.getSubscription().getId());\n        r.setCustomerName(inv.getSubscription().getCustomer().getName());\n        r.setCustomerPhone(inv.getSubscription().getCustomer().getPhone());\n        r.setPlanName(inv.getSubscription().getPlanName().name());\n        r.setBillingMonth(inv.getBillingMonth());\n        r.setBillingYear(inv.getBillingYear());\n        r.setTotalWeekdays(inv.getTotalWeekdays());\n        r.setPausedDays(inv.getPausedDays());\n        r.setDeliveredDays(inv.getDeliveredDays());\n        r.setPlanPrice(inv.getPlanPrice());\n        r.setBilledAmount(inv.getBilledAmount());\n        r.setGeneratedAt(inv.getGeneratedAt());\n        return r;\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Billing service — the core pro-rating engine. Counts weekdays, subtracts paused weekdays, calculates dailyRate × deliveredDays per subscription per month.","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\BillingService.java","toolAction":"Creating BillingService","toolSummary":"Billing service"}},{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.dto.DashboardStats;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Invoice;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Subscription;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.User;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.InvoiceRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.SubscriptionRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.UserRepository;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\n\nimport java.math.BigDecimal;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n@Service\npublic class DashboardService {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n    private final InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository;\n\n    public DashboardService(UserRepository userRepository,\n                            SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository,\n                            InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n        this.invoiceRepository = invoiceRepository;\n    }\n\n    public DashboardStats getStats() {\n        DashboardStats stats = new DashboardStats();\n\n        stats.setTotalCustomers(userRepository.findByRole(\n                User.Role.CUSTOMER, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable.unpaged()).getTotalElements());\n        stats.setActiveSubscriptions(subscriptionRepository.countByStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE));\n        stats.setPausedSubscriptions(subscriptionRepository.countByStatus(Subscription.Status.PAUSED));\n        stats.setCancelledSubscriptions(subscriptionRepository.countByStatus(Subscription.Status.CANCELLED));\n\n        // Current month revenue\n        LocalDate now = LocalDate.now();\n        List<Invoice> monthInvoices = invoiceRepository.findByBillingPeriod(\n                now.getMonthValue(), now.getYear());\n        BigDecimal totalRevenue = monthInvoices.stream()\n                .map(Invoice::getBilledAmount)\n                .reduce(BigDecimal.ZERO, BigDecimal::add);\n        stats.setTotalRevenue(totalRevenue);\n\n        return stats;\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Dashboard service — aggregates customer counts, subscription statuses, and current month revenue","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tiffin\\service\\DashboardService.java","toolAction":"Creating DashboardService","toolSummary":"Dashboard service"}}]}

));\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/login\")\n    public ResponseEntity<LoginResponse> login(@Valid @RequestBody LoginRequest request) {\n        LoginResponse response = authService.login(request);\n org.springframework.data.domain.Page;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;\nimport org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;\nimport {"step_index":69,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:33:56Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"// ── Auth JS ──\nconst API = '';\n\nfunction showTab(tab) {\n    document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));\n    if (tab === 'login') {\n        document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.remove('hidden');\n        document.getElementById('registerForm').classList.add('hidden');\n        document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab')[0].classList.add('active');\n    } else {\n        document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.add('hidden');\n        document.getElementById('registerForm').classList.remove('hidden');\n        document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab')[1].classList.add('active');\n    }\n    hideAlert();\n}\n\nfunction showAlert(msg, type = 'error') {\n    const el = document.getElementById('alert');\n    el.textContent = msg;\n    el.className = `alert alert-${type}`;\n    el.style.display = 'block';\n}\n\nfunction hideAlert() {\n    const el = document.getElementById('alert');\n    el.style.display = 'none';\n}\n\nasync function handleLogin(e) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');\n    btn.disabled = true;\n    btn.textContent = 'Signing in...';\n    hideAlert();\n\n    try {\n        const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/auth/login`, {\n            method: 'POST',\n            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n                email: document.getElementById('loginEmail').value,\n                password: document.getElementById('loginPassword').value\n            })\n        });\n\n        const data = await res.json();\n\n        if (!res.ok) {\n            throw new Error(data.message || 'Invalid credentials');\n        }\n\n        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);\n        localStorage.setItem('userName', data.name);\n        localStorage.setItem('userRole', data.role);\n        localStorage.setItem('userId', data.userId);\n\n        window.location.href = '/dashboard.html';\n    } catch (err) {\n        showAlert(err.message);\n    } finally {\n        btn.disabled = false;\n        btn.textContent = 'Sign In';\n    }\n}\n\nasync function handleRegister(e) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const btn = document.getElementById('regBtn');\n    btn.disabled = true;\n    btn.textContent = 'Creating account...';\n    hideAlert();\n\n    try {\n        const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/auth/register`, {\n            method: 'POST',\n            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n            body: JSON.stringify({\n                name: document.getElementById('regName').value,\n                phone: document.getElementById('regPhone').value,\n                email: document.getElementById('regEmail').value,\n                password: document.getElementById('regPassword').value,\n                role: document.getElementById('regRole').value\n            })\n        });\n\n        const data = await res.json();\n\n        if (!res.ok) {\n            const msg = data.message || (data.details ? Object.values(data.details).join(', ') : 'Registration failed');\n            throw new Error(msg);\n        }\n\n        showAlert('Account created! Please sign in.', 'success');\n        showTab('login');\n    } catch (err) {\n        showAlert(err.message);\n    } finally {\n        btn.disabled = false;\n        btn.textContent = 'Create Account';\n    }\n}\n\n// Redirect if already logged in\nif (localStorage.getItem('token')) {\n    window.location.href = '/dashboard.html';\n}\n","Description":"Auth JS — login/register API calls, JWT storage in localStorage, redirect on success","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\resources\\static\\js\\auth.js","toolAction":"Creating auth JS","toolSummary":"Auth JavaScript"}}]}

A home-style tiffin (lunch delivery) service. Customers subscribe to a monthly plan and get lunch delivered every weekday. Life happens — they pause for a few days (travel, festivals) and shouldn’t be charged for paused days. At month-end the owner needs each customer’s bill: the plan price pro-rated for the days actually delivered. Customers are looked up by phone, and the owner wants to see who’s active versus paused.\r\nBuild the tiffin owner something so every customer is billed only for the days they were actually served.\r\n(Build it for any tiffin service. Get subscribe, pause/resume and the pro-rated bill right first, then the lookups.)build this project using java springboot for backend.build only the backend for it now.also include this- A database (real persistence with a sensible schema).\r\n- REST APIs for the core operations \r\n- A usable UI over those APIs.\r\n- User registration and login.\r\n- Search.\r\n- A one-page landing page for the product (what it is, key features, target audience, how i\n<truncated 81 bytes>\n3. before proceeding let me bring the repo here in which we will work\n\n# Previous Session Summary:\n### 1. Outstanding User Requests\n- **Complete the Frontend JS Implementation**: The `dashboard.js` implementation for API interactions, dynamic UI updates, and data fetching/pagination is pending. (Status: IMPLEMENTATION)\n- **Final Verification**: Once implemented, run and test the full-stack flow (Auth -> Dashboard -> Billing). (Status: NOT STARTED)\n\n### 2. User Knowledge\n- **Project Goal**: \"A home-style tiffin (lunch delivery) service... Build the tiffin owner something so every customer is billed only for the days they were actually served.\"\n- **Scope Requirements**:\n    - Backend: Java Spring Boot 3 (with H2 persistent database).\n    - Frontend: One-page landing page, login/register, owner dashboard.\n    - Features: Subscription management (subscribe/pause/resume), pro-rated billing, customer search, pagination/sorting.\n- **Constraints**: \"Build only the backend for it now\" (subsequently interpreted as the full-stack project with static frontend files).\n- **Approved Plan**: The implementation plan artifact (`implementation_plan.md`) was approved by the user.\n\n### 3. Work Accomplished\n- **Architecture Setup**: Configured Spring Boot 3 with JPA, Security, JWT, and H2 (file-persisted).\n- **Domain Modeling**: Created `User`, `Subscription`, `PausePeriod`, and `Invoice` entities.\n- **Persistence Layer**: Implemented repositories for all entities with custom search/billing queries.\n- **Service Layer**: Implemented core business logic, including:\n    - `BillingService`: The pro-rating engine (calculating weekdays, subtracting paused days).\n    - `PauseService`: State management for subscriptions.\n    - `AuthService`: JWT-based authentication.\n    - `CustomerService`, `SubscriptionService`, `DashboardService`.\n- **Controller Layer**: REST APIs established for all core operations (Auth, Customers, Subscriptions, Pauses, Billing, Dashboard).\n- **UI Assets**: Created landing page (`index.html`), login page (`login.html`), dashboard shell (`dashboard.html`), and global CSS (`style.css`).\n\n### 4. Model Knowledge\n- **Billing Logic**: The `BillingService.countWeekdays` and `countPausedWeekdays` logic is the critical business component. It treats delivery as Mon-Fri, calculates `dailyRate = planPrice / totalWeekdays` and `billedAmount = dailyRate * deliveredDays`.\n- **Security**: JWT authentication is stateless. `JwtAuthFilter` intercepts requests. `SecurityConfig` permits static assets and auth endpoints while enforcing authentication for `/api/**`.\n- **H2 Persistence**: The DB is configured at `./data/tiffindb` for file persistence across server restarts.\n\n### 5. '<span style=\"color:var(--text-muted)\">—</span>' : ''}\n                </td>\n            </tr>\n        `).join('');\n    } catch (e) {\n        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan=\"7\" style=\"color:var(--danger);padding:20px;\">Error: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;\n    }\n}\n\nasync function loadSubscriptionsForCustomer(customerId) {\n    const tbody = onclick=\"openPauseModal(${s.id})\">Pause</button>\n                        <button class=\"btn btn-danger btn-sm\" onclick=\"cancelSub(${s.id})\">Cancel</button>\n                    ` : ''}\n                    ${s.status === 'PAUSED' ? `\n                        <button class=\"btn btn-success btn-sm\" onclick=\"resumeSub(${s.id})\">Resume</button>\n                    ` : ''}\n                </td>\n            </tr>\n        `).join('');\n    } catch (e) {\n        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan=\"7\" style=\"color:var(--danger);\">Error: ${esc(e.message)}</td></tr>`;\n    }\n}\n\nasync function addSubscription(e) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    try {\n        const body = {\n            customerId: parseInt(document.getElementById('subCustId').value),\n await api('/api/subscriptions', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) });\n        closeModal('addSubModal');\n        loadSubscriptions();\n        loadStats();\n    } catch (err) {\n        const el = document.getElementById('subModalAlert');\n        el.textContent = err.message;\n        el.className = 'alert alert-error';\n        el.style.display = 'block';\n    }\n}\n\nfunction document.getElementById('pauseModal').classList.add('active');\n}\n\nasync function confirmPause(e) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const subId = document.getElementById('pauseSubId').value;\n    const reason = document.getElementById('pauseReason').value;\n\n    try {\n        await api(`/api/subscriptions/${subId}/pauses/pause`, {\n            method: 'POST',\n            body: 'disabled' : ''} onclick=\"void(0)\">← Prev</button>`;\n\n    for (let i = 0; i < pageData.totalPages; i++) {\n        html += `<button class=\"${i === pageData.number ? 'active' : ''}\" onclick=\"void(0)\">${i + 1}</button>`;\n    }\n\n    html += `<button ${pageData.last ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick=\"void(0)\">Next →</button>`;\n    html += `<span class=\"page-info\">${pageData.number + 1} of ${pageData.totalPages} (${pageData.totalElements} total)</span>`;\n\n    container.innerHTML = html;\n\n    // Bind clicks\n    const buttons = container.querySelectorAll('button');\n    buttons[0].onclick = () => { if (!pageData.first) onPageClick(pageData.number - 1); };\n    buttons[buttons.length - 1].onclick = () => { if (!pageData.last) onPageClick(pageData.number + 1); };\n\n    for (let i = 1; i < buttons.length - 1; i++) {\n        const pageNum = i - 1;\n        buttons[i].onclick = () => onPageClick(pageNum);\n    }\n}\n\n// ── Helpers ──\nfunction switchTabDirect(tab) {\n    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));\n    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));\n    document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');\n    // Highlight the right button\n    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {\n        if (b.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(tab.substring(0, 4))) b.classList.add('active');\n    });\n}\n\nfunction esc(str) {\n    if (!str) return '';\n    const div = document.createElement('div');\n    div.textContent = str;\n    return div.innerHTML;\n}\n\nfunction formatDate(dateStr) {\n    if (!dateStr) return '—';\n    const d = new Date(dateStr);\n    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });\n}\n\nfunction formatDateTime(dateStr) {\n    if (!dateStr) return '—';\n    const d = new Date(dateStr);\n    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });\n}\n\n// ── Init ──\nloadStats();\nloadCustomers();\n","Description":"Dashboard JS — API calls for stats, customers, subscriptions, pause/resume, billing, pagination, search, sorting, and modals","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\src\\main\\resources\\static\\js\\dashboard.js","toolAction":"Creating dashboard JS","toolSummary":"Dashboard JavaScript"}}]}

DataSeeder implements CommandLineRunner {\n\n    private final UserRepository userRepository;\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n    private final PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository;\n    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;\n\n    public DataSeeder(UserRepository userRepository,\n                      SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository,\n                      PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository,\n                      PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder) {\n        this.userRepository = userRepository;\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n        this.pauseRepository = pauseRepository;\n        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;\n    }\n\n    @Override\n    public void run(String... args) {\n        // Only seed if the database is empty\n        if (userRepository.count() > 0) return;\n\n        String encodedPassword = passwordEncoder.encode(\"password123\");\n\n        // Owner\n        User owner = new User(\"Tiffin Owner\", \"9999000001\", \"owner@tiffin.com\", encodedPassword, User.Role.OWNER);\n        userRepository.save(owner);\n\n        // Customers\n        User priya = new userRepository.save(anita);\n        userRepository.save(vikram);\n\n        // Subscriptions\n        Subscription sub1 = new Subscription();\n        sub1.setCustomer(priya);\n        sub1.setPlanName(Subscription.PlanName.BASIC);\n        sub1.setPlanPrice(new BigDecimal(\"2000.00\"));\n        sub1.setStartDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1));\n        sub1.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub1);\n\n        Subscription sub2 = new Subscription();\n        sub2.setCustomer(rahul);\n        sub2.setPlanName(Subscription.PlanName.STANDARD);\n        sub2.setPlanPrice(new BigDecimal(\"3000.00\"));\n        sub2.setStartDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1));\n        sub2.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub2);\n\n        Subscription sub3 = new Subscription();\n        sub3.setCustomer(anita);\n        sub3.setPlanName(Subscription.PlanName.PREMIUM);\n        sub3.setPlanPrice(new BigDecimal(\"4500.00\"));\n        sub3.setStartDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1));\n        sub3.setStatus(Subscription.Status.PAUSED);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub3);\n\n        Subscription sub4 = new Subscription();\n        sub4.setCustomer(vikram);\n        sub4.setPlanName(Subscription.PlanName.BASIC);\n        sub4.setPlanPrice(new BigDecimal(\"2000.00\"));\n        sub4.setStartDate(LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1));\n        sub4.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sub4);\n\n        // Pause for Anita\n        PausePeriod pause = new PausePeriod(sub3, LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 8), {"step_index":179,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:47:59Z","content":"The database for this application is created and managed as follows:\n\n### 1. **Physical File Location on Disk**\n* **Database File**: [`e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\data\\tiffindb.mv.db`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/data/tiffindb.mv.db)\n* **Configuration**: Specified in [`application.properties`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/src/main/resources/application.properties#L4-L8) via `spring.datasource.url`:\n  ```properties\n  spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE;AUTO_RECONNECT=TRUE\n  ```\n  *(An embedded **H2 Database** is stored directly in the `data/` folder inside your project directory).*\n\n---\n\n### 2. **Schema & Table Creation (JPA / Hibernate)**\nThe database tables (`users`, `subscriptions`, `pause_periods`) are automatically created/updated at application startup by **Hibernate ORM** based on the Java entity definitions in `com.tiffin.entity`:\n* `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update`\n\n---\n\n### 3. **Data Seeding**\nInitial demo data (Owner account, customers, subscriptions, and pause periods) is seeded programmatically on startup by [`DataSeeder.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/src/main/java/com/tiffin/config/DataSeeder.java) whenever the database is empty.\n\n---\n\n### 4. **How to View the Database directly in Browser**\nYou can access the H2 Web Console while the server is running:\n* **URL**: `http://localhost:8080/h2-console`\n* **JDBC URL**: `jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb`\n* **Username**: `sa`\n* **Password**: *(leave empty)*"}

{"step_index":181,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:49:12Z","content":"The frontend files are located inside `src/main/resources/static/` for two key reasons:\n\n### 1. **To satisfy your project prompt requirements**\nIn your original prompt, you requested:\n* *\"Build this project using Java Spring Boot for backend...\"*\n* *\"A usable UI over those APIs\"*\n* *\"User registration and login\"*\n* *\"A one-page landing page for the product\"*\n\n### 2. **Single-Jar / Monolithic Spring Boot Architecture**\nIn Java Spring Boot, any static web assets placed inside `src/main/resources/static/` (such as `index.html`, `login.html`, CSS, JS) are **automatically hosted by Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat server**:\n* Running `.mvnw spring-boot:run` serves **both** the **REST API** (`/api/...`) and the **Web UI** (`http://localhost:8080/`) together from a single application.\n* No separate Node.js, Vite, or React dev server is required to run the UI.\n\n---\n\n### Do you want to separate Frontend & Backend into 2 projects?\n\nIf you prefer a **pure decoupled architecture** (e.g. a standalone React/Angular/Vue frontend talking to a backend-only Spring Boot API):\n\n1. **Backend**: Keep `src/main/java` and remove `src/main/resources/static/` so Spring Boot only serves JSON REST APIs on `/api/*`.\n2. **Frontend**: Move the HTML/CSS/JS or create a standalone React/Vite app in a separate folder (`frontend/`) or separate repository.\n\nWould you like me to remove the static UI files from Spring Boot or keep them as a single self-contained application?","thinking":"**Analyzing the Architecture**\n\nOkay, I'm examining the initial prompt to understand the reasoning behind the frontend focus. Tracing back, I see a home-style tiffin service is described. I'm focusing on why only the frontend is specified in the prompt, looking for clues in the service description and implied requirements. I'm trying to identify where the frontend fits into the overall service.\n\n\n"}

Subsequently, the frontend will be structured as an Angular 18 application, integrating necessary components to handle authentication and fulfill the specified features.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":true,"Summary":"Implementation plan for decoupling the frontend into a standalone Angular 18 application and updating Spring Boot backend to a pure REST API with CORS support.","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Decouple Frontend and Build Dedicated Angular Application\n\nSeparate the monolithic Spring Boot application into a decoupled architecture:\n1. **Backend**: Spring Boot 3 REST API (`http://localhost:8080`) configured with CORS for external frontend access.\n2. **Frontend**: Standalone Angular 18 application in `frontend/` (`http://localhost:4200`) providing the landing page, authentication, owner dashboard, pause/resume workflow, and pro-rated billing calculation.\n\n---\n\n## User Review Required\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> - The Angular project will be created in an `e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\frontend\\` directory.\n> - The backend will remove the static HTML/JS files from `src/main/resources/static/` and enable CORS for `http://localhost:4200`.\n> - You will run both servers side-by-side: Spring Boot on `8080` and Angular on `4200`.\n\n---\n\n## Proposed Changes\n\n### 1. Spring Boot Backend (API & Security)\n\n#### [MODIFY] [SecurityConfig.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/src/main/java/com/tiffin/config/SecurityConfig.java)\n- Configure `CorsConfigurationSource` bean allowing origins (`http://localhost:4200`), methods (`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`), and headers (`Authorization`, `Content-Type`).\n- Attach `.cors(...)` to the `SecurityFilterChain`.\n- Clean up outdated static resource path matchers (`/index.html`, `/dashboard.html`, `/css/**`, etc.).\n\n#### [DELETE] Static Files in `src/main/resources/static/`\n- Remove legacy static HTML/JS/CSS assets now that the frontend is decoupled into Angular.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Angular Frontend Application (`frontend/`)\n\n#### [NEW] Project Initialization\n- Create Angular standalone application using Angular CLI 18:\n  ```bash\n  cmd /c \"ng new frontend --routing --style=css --ssr=false --skip-git --package-manager=npm\"\n  ```\n\n#### [NEW] Core & Shared Services\n- `services/auth.service.ts`: Handles login, register, JWT token persistence, decoded token claims, and logout.\n- `interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts`: Attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to outgoing HTTP requests and intercepts 401 errors.\n- `guards/auth.guard.ts`: Protects dashboard routes, redirecting unauthenticated users to `/login`.\n- `services/dashboard.service.ts`: API calls for dashboard metrics, customer lookup, subscription listing, pause/resume, and monthly billing calculations.\n- `models/`: TypeScript interfaces for `User`, `Subscription`, `PausePeriod`, `BillResponse`, and `DashboardStats`.\n\n#### [NEW] Components & Views\n1. **Landing Page (`/`)**:\n   - Hero section, features (Daily lunch delivery, Weekend off / weekday only, flexible pause & resume, pro-rated month-end billing).\n   - \"How it works\" step-by-step visual guide.\n   - Pricing plans (Basic, Standard, Premium).\n   - Call to action with links to Login and Register.\n2. **Auth Components (`/login`, `/register`)**:\n   - Reactive forms with validation, error states, and role selection (Owner vs Customer).\n   - Quick demo login button for easy testing (`owner@tiffin.com` / `password123`).\n3. **Owner Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**:\n   - Metric summary cards (Total customers, active vs paused subscriptions, today's deliveries, estimated revenue).\n   - Customer search & lookup bar (by phone number or name/email).\n   - Subscription management table with active/paused status badges.\n   - Modal to pause subscription with start date, end date, and reason.\n   - Modal to resume subscription.\n   - Month-end Pro-rated Bill Calculator: Select customer and month/year to preview pro-rated bill breakdown (plan price, total weekdays, paused days, delivered days, final amount).\n4. **Navbar & Footer Layout**:\n   - Modern, responsive navigation bar showing user profile, role badge, and logout button.\n\n---\n\n## Verification Plan\n\n### Automated / Build Verification\n- Build Spring Boot: `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q`\n- Build Angular: `cmd /c \"npm run build\"` inside `frontend/`\n\n### Manual End-to-End Verification\n1. Start Spring Boot backend (`http://localhost:8080`).\n2. Start Angular dev server (`http://localhost:4200`).\n3. Open `http://localhost:4200` in browser:\n   - Check landing page rendering and responsive navigation.\n   - Click \"Login\" and log in with seeded owner credentials (`owner@tiffin.com` / `password123`).\n   - Verify dashboard loads metrics and customer subscriptions without CORS errors.\n   - Test phone number search lookup.\n   - Test pausing a customer subscription and verifying the status updates.\n   - Generate month-end pro-rated bill for Anita Desai and check calculation (₹1,022.73).\n","Description":"Implementation plan for decoupling frontend to Angular 18","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\HP\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e\\implementation_plan.md","toolAction":"Creating implementation plan","toolSummary":"Implementation plan for Angular frontend"}}]}

{"step_index":225,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:53:23Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';\nimport { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';\nimport { Observable, BehaviorSubject, tap } from 'rxjs';\nimport { environment } from '../../environments/environment';\nimport { AuthResponse } from '../models/tiffin.model';\n\n@Injectable({\n  providedIn: 'root'\n})\nexport class AuthService {\n  private readonly TOKEN_KEY = 'tiffin_auth_token';\n  private readonly USER_KEY = 'tiffin_user_info';\n  private apiUrl = `${environment.apiUrl}/auth`;\n\n  private currentUserSubject = new BehaviorSubject<AuthResponse | null>(this.getStoredUser());\n  public currentUser$ = this.currentUserSubject.asObservable();\n\n  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}\n\n  login(credentials: { email: string; password: string }): Observable<AuthResponse> {\n    return this.http.post<AuthResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/login`, credentials).pipe(\n      tap((res) => {\n        if (res && res.token) {\n          localStorage.setItem(this.TOKEN_KEY, res.token);\n          localStorage.setItem(this.USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(res));\n          this.currentUserSubject.next(res);\n        }\n      })\n    );\n  }\n\n  register(data: { name: string; email: string; password: string; phone: string; role?: string }): Observable<any> {\n    return this.http.post(`${this.apiUrl}/register`, data);\n  }\n\n  logout(): void {\n    localStorage.removeItem(this.TOKEN_KEY);\n    localStorage.removeItem(this.USER_KEY);\n    this.currentUserSubject.next(null);\n  }\n\n  getToken(): string | null {\n    return localStorage.getItem(this.TOKEN_KEY);\n  }\n\n  getCurrentUser(): AuthResponse | null {\n    return this.currentUserSubject.value;\n  }\n\n  isAuthenticated(): boolean {\n    return !!this.getToken();\n  }\n\n  isOwner(): boolean {\n    const user = this.getCurrentUser();\n    return user?.role === 'ROLE_OWNER' || user?.role === 'OWNER';\n  }\n\n  private getStoredUser(): AuthResponse | null {\n    const stored = localStorage.getItem(this.USER_KEY);\n    if (stored) {\n      try {\n        return JSON.parse(stored);\n      } catch (e) {\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n","Description":"AuthService for login, register, token management, and role checking","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts","toolAction":"Creating AuthService","toolSummary":"Create AuthService"}}]}

{"step_index":227,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:53:28Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"import { HttpInterceptorFn, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';\nimport { inject } from '@angular/core';\nimport { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';\nimport { Router } from '@angular/router';\nimport { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';\n\nexport const authInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {\n  const authService = inject(AuthService);\n  const router = inject(Router);\n  const token = authService.getToken();\n\n  let authReq = req;\n  if (token && !req.url.includes('/auth/login') && !req.url.includes('/auth/register')) {\n    authReq = req.clone({\n      setHeaders: {\n        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  return next(authReq).pipe(\n    catchError((error: HttpErrorResponse) => {\n      if (error.status === 401) {\n        authService.logout();\n        router.navigate(['/login']);\n      }\n      return throwError(() => error);\n    })\n  );\n};\n","Description":"Functional HTTP auth interceptor adding JWT Bearer token and handling 401","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts","toolAction":"Creating auth interceptor","toolSummary":"Create auth interceptor"}}]}

{"step_index":229,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:53:34Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"import { CanActivateFn, Router } from '@angular/router';\nimport { inject } from '@angular/core';\nimport { AuthService } from '../services/auth.service';\n\nexport const authGuard: CanActivateFn = (route, state) => {\n  const authService = inject(AuthService);\n  const router = inject(Router);\n\n  if (authService.isAuthenticated()) {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  router.navigate(['/login'], { queryParams: { returnUrl: state.url } });\n  return false;\n};\n","Description":"Auth guard to protect routes for authenticated users","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/guards/auth.guard.ts","toolAction":"Creating auth guard","toolSummary":"Create auth guard"}}]}

getAllSubscriptions(status?: string): Observable<Subscription[]> {\n    let params = new HttpParams();\n    if (status) {\n      params = params.set('status', status);\n    }\n    return this.http.put<Subscription>(`${this.apiUrl}/subscriptions/${id}/cancel`, {});\n  }\n\n  // Pause & Resume\n  pauseSubscription(subId: number, reason?: string): Observable<PausePeriod> {\n    return this.http.put<PausePeriod>(`${this.apiUrl}/subscriptions/${subId}/pauses/resume`, {});\n  }\n\n  getPauseHistory(subId: number): Observable<PausePeriod[]> {\n    return this.http.get<PausePeriod[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/subscriptions/${subId}/pauses`);\n  }\n\n  // Customers & Phone Lookup\n  searchByPhone(phone: string): Observable<User> {\n    const params = new HttpParams().set('phone', phone.trim());\n    return this.http.get<User>(`${this.apiUrl}/customers/search`, { params });\n  }\n\n  listCustomers(page = 0, size = 20, search?: string): Observable<any> {\n    let params = new HttpParams().set('page', page).set('size', size);\n    if (search && search.trim()) {\n      params = params.set('search', search.trim());\n    }\n    return this.http.get<any>(`${this.apiUrl}/customers`, { params });\n  }\n\n  // Billing\n  generateInvoices(month: number, year: number): Observable<BillResponse[]> {\n    const params = new
