'alert-danger' : 'alert-success'\">\n        {{ alertMessage }}\n        <button class=\"close-alert\" (click)=\"alertMessage = ''\">×</button>\n      </div>\n\n      <!-- Stats Grid -->\n      <section class=\"stats-grid\">\n        <div class=\"stat-card\">\n          <div class=\"stat-header\">\n            <span class=\"stat-label\">Total Customers</span>\n            <span class=\"stat-icon\">👥</span>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"stat-value\">{{ stats?.totalCustomers ?? 0 }}</div>\n          <div class=\"stat-sub\">Registered foodies</div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"stat-card stat-card-active\">\n          <div class=\"stat-header\">\n            <span class=\"stat-label\">Active Delivering</span>\n            <span class=\"stat-icon\">🟢</span>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"stat-value text-success\">{{ stats?.activeSubscriptions ?? 0 }}</div>\n          <div class=\"stat-sub\">Meals being prepared today</div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"stat-card stat-card-paused\">\n          <div class=\"stat-header\">\n            <span class=\"stat-label\">Currently Paused</span>\n            <span class=\"stat-icon\">⏸️</span>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"stat-value text-warning\">{{ stats?.pausedSubscriptions ?? 0 }}</div>\n          <div class=\"stat-sub\">Not billed during pause</div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"stat-card\">\n          <div class=\"stat-header\">\n            <span class=\"stat-label\">Monthly Potential</span>\n            <span class=\"stat-icon\">💰</span>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"stat-value\">₹{{ stats?.monthlyRevenueEstimate | number:'1.0-0' }}</div>\n          <div class=\"stat-sub\">Before pause deductions</div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <!-- Lookup by Phone & Search Toolbar -->\n      <section class=\"toolbar-card\">\n        <div class=\"toolbar-grid\">\n          <!-- Quick Phone Lookup -->\n          <div class=\"lookup-box\">\n            <label class=\"toolbar-label\">Instant Phone Lookup</label>\n            <div class=\"input-with-button\">\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                [(ngModel)]=\"searchPhone\"\n                (keyup.enter)=\"lookupByPhone()\"\n                placeholder=\"Lookup phone (e.g. 9876543211)\"\n                class=\"form-control\"\n              />\n              <button class=\"btn btn-secondary\" (click)=\"lookupByPhone()\">Lookup</button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <!-- General Search & Filter -->\n          <div class=\"filter-box\">\n            <label class=\"toolbar-label\">Filter Subscriptions</label>\n            <div class=\"filter-controls\">\n              <div class=\"tabs\">\n                <button\n                  class=\"tab-btn\"\n                  [class.active]=\"selectedStatus === 'ALL'\"\n                  (click)=\"filterByStatus('ALL')\"\n                >\n                  All ({{ subscriptions.length }})\n                </button>\n                <button\n                  class=\"tab-btn tab-active\"\n                  [class.active]=\"selectedStatus === 'ACTIVE'\"\n                  (click)=\"filterByStatus('ACTIVE')\"\n                >\n                  Active ({{ countStatus('ACTIVE') }})\n                </button>\n                <button\n                  class=\"tab-btn tab-paused\"\n                  [class.active]=\"selectedStatus === 'PAUSED'\"\n                  (click)=\"filterByStatus('PAUSED')\"\n                >\n                  Paused ({{ countStatus('PAUSED') }})\n                </button>\n              </div>\n\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                [(ngModel)]=\"searchQuery\"\n                (ngModelChange)=\"applyLocalFilter()\"\n                placeholder=\"Search name or plan...\"\n                class=\"form-control search-input\"\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <!-- Phone Lookup Result Banner if found -->\n        <div *ngIf=\"lookupResult\" class=\"phone-result-card\">\n          <div class=\"phone-result-header\">\n            <div>\n              <span class=\"result-badge\">Customer Found</span>\n              <h3>{{ lookupResult.name }}</h3>\n              <p>Phone: {{ lookupResult.phone }} • Email: {{ lookupResult.email }}</p>\n            </div>\n            <button class=\"btn btn-outline btn-sm\" (click)=\"lookupResult = null\">Dismiss</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <!-- Subscriptions Table -->\n      <section class=\"table-card\">\n        <div class=\"table-header\">\n          <h2>Customer Subscriptions</h2>\n          <span class=\"table-count\">Showing {{ filteredSubscriptions.length }} subscriptions</span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class=\"table-responsive\">\n          <table class=\"data-table\">\n            <thead>\n              <tr>\n                <th>Customer</th>\n                <th>Plan Details</th>\n                <th>Status</th>\n                <th>Start Date</th>\n                <th>Pause Details</th>\n                <th class=\"text-right\">Actions</th>\n              </tr>\n            </thead>\n            <tbody>\n              <tr *ngFor=\"let sub of filteredSubscriptions\">\n                <td>\n                  <div class=\"customer-info\">\n                    <span class=\"customer-name\">{{ sub.customer?.name }}</span>\n class=\"plan-info\">\n                    <span class=\"badge\" [ngClass]=\"'badge-plan-' + sub.planName.toLowerCase()\">\n                      {{ sub.planName }}\n                    </span>\n     class=\"badge\"\n                    [ngClass]=\"sub.status === 'ACTIVE' ? 'badge-active' : (sub.status === 'PAUSED' ? <span *ngIf=\"sub.currentPause.reason\">({{ sub.currentPause.reason }})</span>\n                  </span>\n                  <span *ngIf=\"sub.status !== 'PAUSED'\" class=\"text-muted text-sm\">\n                    Delivering Mon–Fri\n                  </span>\n                </td>\n                <td class=\"text-right actions-col\">\n                  <!-- Pause Button if ACTIVE -->\n                  <button\n                    *ngIf=\"sub.status === 'ACTIVE'\"\n                    class=\"btn btn-outline btn-sm btn-action-pause\"\n                    (click)=\"openPauseModal(sub)\"\n 'PAUSED'\"\n                    class=\"btn btn-primary btn-sm btn-action-resume\"\n                    (click)=\"resumeSubscription(sub)\"\n                  >\n                    ▶️ Resume\n                  </button>\n\n                  <!-- Pro-rate / Billing -->\n                  <button\n                    class=\"btn btn-outline btn-sm\"\n                    (click)=\"openSubBilling(sub)\"\n                    title=\"Calculate pro-rated bill\"\n                  >\n                    🧾 Bill\n                  </button>\n                </td>\n              </tr>\n\n              <tr *ngIf=\"filteredSubscriptions.length === 0\">\n                <td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty-state\">\n                  <div class=\"empty-box\">\n                    <p>No subscriptions match your search or filter.</p>\n                  </div>\n                </td>\n              </tr>\n            </tbody>\n          </table>\n        </div>\n      </section>\n\n      <!-- ── Pause Modal ── -->\n      <div class=\"modal-backdrop\" *ngIf=\"showPauseModal\">\n        <div class=\"modal-card\">\n          <div class=\"modal-header\">\n            <h3>Pause Subscription</h3>\n            <button class=\"modal-close\" (click)=\"showPauseModal = false\">×</button>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"modal-body\">\n            <p class=\"modal-intro\">\n              Pause deliveries for <strong>{{ targetSubscription?.customer?.name }}</strong>.\n              Paused weekdays will not be billed.\n            </p>\n            <div class=\"form-group\">\n              <label class=\"form-label\">Reason (optional)</label>\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                [(ngModel)]=\"pauseReason\"\n                class=\"form-control\"\n                placeholder=\"e.g. Vacation, Visiting hometown, Festival\"\n              />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"modal-footer\">\n            <button class=\"btn btn-outline\" (click)=\"showPauseModal = false\">Cancel</button>\n            <button class=\"btn btn-warning\" (click)=\"confirmPause()\">Confirm Pause</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <!-- ── Pro-Rated Bill Calculator Modal ── -->\n      <div class=\"modal-backdrop\" *ngIf=\"showBillingModal\">\n        <div class=\"modal-card modal-lg\">\n          <div class=\"modal-header\">\n            <h3>Month-End Pro-Rated Billing</h3>\n            <button class=\"modal-close\" (click)=\"showBillingModal = false\">×</button>\n          </div>\n          <div class=\"modal-body\">\n            <div class=\"billing-controls\">\n              <div class=\"form-group\">\n                <label class=\"form-label\">Month</label>\n                <select [(ngModel)]=\"billingMonth\" class=\"form-control\">\n                  <option            <option [value]=\"8\">August</option>\n                  <option [value]=\"9\">September</option>\n                  <option [value]=\"10\">October</option>\n                  <option <label class=\"form-label\">Year</label>\n                <input type=\"number\" [(ngModel)]=\"billingYear\" class=\"form-control\" />\n              </div>\n              <div class=\"form-group btn-align\">\n                <button class=\"btn btn-primary\" (click)=\"generateInvoices()\" [disabled]=\"calculatingBill\">\n                  {{ calculatingBill ? 'Calculating...' : 'Generate Invoices' }}\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <!-- Invoices Table -->\n            <div *ngIf=\"invoices.length > 0\" class=\"invoices-list\">\n              <div class=\"table-responsive\">\n                <table class=\"data-table\">\n                  <thead>\n                    <tr>\n                      <th>Customer</th>\n                      <th>Plan</th>\n                      <th>Total Wkdays</th>\n                      <th>Paused</th>\n                      <th>Delivered</th>\n                      <th>Monthly Fee</th>\n                      <th>Pro-Rated Bill</th>\n                    </tr>\n                  </thead>\n                  <tbody>\n                    <tr *ngFor=\"let inv of invoices\">\n                      <td>\n                        <strong>{{ inv.customerName }}</strong>\n                        <div class=\"text-sm text-muted\">{{ inv.customerPhone }}</div>\n                      </td>\n                      <td>\n                        <span class=\"badge badge-plan-standard\">{{ inv.planName }}</span>\n                      </td>\n                      <td>{{ inv.totalWeekdays }} days</td>\n                      <td class=\"text-warning font-bold\">{{ inv.pausedDays }} days</td>\n                      <td class=\"text-success font-bold\">{{ inv.deliveredDays }} days</td>\n                      <td>₹{{ inv.planPrice | number:'1.2-2' }}</td>\n                      <td>\n                        <span class=\"final-bill-amount\">₹{{ inv.billedAmount | number:'1.2-2' }}</span>\n                      </td>\n                    </tr>\n                  </tbody>\n                </table>\n              </div>\n\n              <div class=\"billing-explainer\">\n                💡 <strong>Fair Pro-rating Rule:</strong> Daily Rate = (Plan Price ÷ Total Weekdays in Month). <button class=\"btn btn-outline\" (click)=\"showBillingModal = false\">Close</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <!-- ── New Subscription Modal ── -->\n      <div `]\n})\nexport class DashboardComponent implements OnInit {\n  stats: DashboardStats | null = null;\n  subscriptions: any[] = [];\n  filteredSubscriptions: any[] = [];\n  customersList: any[] = [];\n\n  // Filter state\n  selectedStatus = 'ALL';\n  searchQuery = '';\n  searchPhone = '';\n  lookupResult: User | null = null;\n\n  // Alerts\n  alertMessage = '';\n  alertType: 'success' | 'error' = 'success';\n\n  // Pause Modal\n  showPauseModal = false;\n  targetSubscription: any = null;\n  pauseReason = '';\n\n  // Billing Modal\n  showBillingModal = false;\n  billingMonth = new newSubCustomerId: number | null = null;\n  newSubPlan = 'STANDARD';\n\n  constructor(\n    private tiffinService: TiffinService,\n    public authService: AuthService\n  ) {}\n\n  ngOnInit(): void {\n    this.loadStats();\n    this.loadSubscriptions();\n    this.loadCustomers();\n  }\n\n  loadStats(): void {\n    this.tiffinService.getDashboardStats().subscribe({\n      next: (res) => this.stats = res,\n      error: (err) => console.error('Error fetching stats', err)\n    });\n  }\n\n  loadSubscriptions(): void {\n    this.tiffinService.getAllSubscriptions().subscribe({\n      next: (res) => {\n        this.subscriptions = res;\n        this.applyLocalFilter();\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert('Error loading subscriptions', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  loadCustomers(): void {\n    this.tiffinService.listCustomers(0, 50).subscribe({\n      next: (res) => {\n        this.customersList = res.content || [];\n      },\n      error: (err) => console.error('Error fetching customers', err)\n    });\n  }\n\n  applyLocalFilter(): void {\n    let list = [...this.subscriptions];\n\n    if (this.selectedStatus !== 'ALL') {\n      list = list.filter(s => s.status === this.selectedStatus);\n    }\n\n    if (this.searchQuery.trim()) {\n      const q = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();\n      list = list.filter(s =>\n        s.customer?.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||\n        s.customer?.phone?.includes(q) ||\n        s.planName?.toLowerCase().includes(q)\n      );\n    }\n\n    this.filteredSubscriptions = list;\n  }\n\n  filterByStatus(status: string): void {\n    this.selectedStatus = status;\n    this.applyLocalFilter();\n  }\n\n  countStatus(status: string): number {\n    return this.subscriptions.filter(s => s.status === status).length;\n  }\n\n  lookupByPhone(): void {\n    if (!this.searchPhone.trim()) {\n      this.lookupResult = null;\n      return;\n    }\n    this.tiffinService.searchByPhone(this.searchPhone.trim()).subscribe({\n      next: (customer) => {\n        this.lookupResult = customer;\n        this.searchQuery = customer.phone;\n        this.applyLocalFilter();\n      },\n      error: () => {\n        this.showAlert(`No customer found with phone: ${this.searchPhone}`, 'error');\n        this.lookupResult = null;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Pause\n  openPauseModal(sub: any): void {\n    this.targetSubscription = sub;\n    this.pauseReason = '';\n    this.showPauseModal = true;\n  }\n\n  confirmPause(): void {\n    if (!this.targetSubscription) return;\n    this.tiffinService.pauseSubscription(this.targetSubscription.id, this.pauseReason).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showPauseModal = false;\n        this.showAlert(`Subscription for ${this.targetSubscription.customer?.name} paused successfully.`);\n        this.loadSubscriptions();\n        this.loadStats();\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to pause subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Resume\n  resumeSubscription(sub: any): void {\n    this.tiffinService.resumeSubscription(sub.id).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showAlert(`Subscription for ${sub.customer?.name} resumed successfully!`);\n        this.loadSubscriptions();\n        this.loadStats();\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to resume subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Billing\n  openBillingModal(): void {\n    this.showBillingModal = true;\n    this.generateInvoices();\n  }\n\n  openSubBilling(sub: any): void {\n    this.showBillingModal = true;\n    this.generateInvoices();\n  }\n\n  generateInvoices(): void {\n    this.calculatingBill = true;\n    this.tiffinService.generateInvoices(this.billingMonth, this.billingYear).subscribe({\n      next: (res) => {\n        this.invoices = res;\n        this.calculatingBill = false;\n      },\n      error: (err) => {\n        this.calculatingBill = false;\n        this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Error generating invoices', 'error');\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // New Subscription\n  openNewSubModal(): void {\n    this.showNewSubModal = true;\n  }\n\n  createSubscription(): void {\n    if (!this.newSubCustomerId) return;\n    this.tiffinService.createSubscription({\n      customerId: this.newSubCustomerId,\n      planName: this.newSubPlan\n    }).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showNewSubModal = false;\n        this.showAlert('Subscription created successfully!');\n        this.loadSubscriptions();\n        this.loadStats();\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to create subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  private showAlert(msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success'): void {\n    this.alertMessage = {"step_index":309,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:58:59Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"# TiffinBox — Lunch Delivery & Pro-Rated Billing Service\n\nA modern decoupled system for home-style tiffin delivery services. Customers subscribe to monthly plans for weekday lunches, pause whenever life happens (travel, festivals), and are billed pro-rated at month-end exclusively for the days actually served.\n\n---\n\n## 📁 Repository Structure\n\n```\nAurigaIT/\n├── backend/                  # Java 17 + Spring Boot 3 REST API\n│   ├── src/                  # Controllers, Entities, Repositories, Services, Security\n│   ├── data/                 # Embedded H2 Database (tiffindb.mv.db)\n│   ├── pom.xml               # Maven configuration\n│   └── mvnw.cmd              # Maven wrapper\n│\n└── frontend/                 # Angular 18 Single-Page Application\n    ├── src/\n    │   ├── app/\n    │   │   ├── components/   # Navbar, Landing, Login, Register, Dashboard\n    │   │   ├── guards/       # Route guards (AuthGuard)\n    │   │   ├── interceptors/ # HTTP JWT Bearer Interceptor\n    │   │   ├── models/       # TypeScript interfaces\n    │   │   └── services/     # AuthService, TiffinService\n    │   ├── environments/     # API endpoints configuration\n    │   └── styles.css        # Global CSS design system\n    ├── angular.json\n    └── package.json\n```\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 Quick Start Guide\n\n### 1. Start the Backend (Spring Boot)\nOpen a terminal in `backend/`:\n```bash\ncd backend\n.\\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n```\n* **API Base URL**: `http://localhost:8080/api`\n* **Swagger UI / OpenAPI**: `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui/index.html`\n* **H2 Database Console**: `http://localhost:8080/h2-console`\n  - JDBC URL: `jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb`\n  - Username: `sa`\n  - Password: *(leave blank)*\n\n### 2. Start the Frontend (Angular)\nOpen another terminal in `frontend/`:\n```bash\ncd frontend\nnpm start\n```\n* **Web App**: `http://localhost:4200`\n\n---\n\n## 🔑 Default Seed Credentials\nThe backend automatically seeds an owner account and 4 customers upon first run:\n\n| Role | Email | Password | Phone |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **Owner** | `owner@tiffin.com` | `password123` | `9876543210` |\n| Customer (Anita Desai - Paused Demo) | `anita@example.com` | `password123` | `9876543211` |\n| Customer (Vikram Patel) | `vikram@example.com` | `password123` | `9876543212` |\n| Customer (Priya Sharma) | `priya@example.com` | `password123` | `9876543213` |\n| Customer (Rahul Verma) | `rahul@example.com` | `password123` | `9876543214` |\n\n---\n\n## ✨ Features\n\n1. **One-Page Product Landing**: Modern marketing page with interactive live calculator, feature highlights, 3-step workflow, transparent pricing tiers, and call-to-actions.\n2. **JWT Authentication & Role Control**:\n   - Customer and Owner registration with 10-digit phone and password.\n   - Secure login with JWT token storage, automatic request header injection via Angular HTTP Interceptor, and route guards.\n3. **Owner Operations Dashboard**:\n   - Real-time statistics: Total customers, active deliveries today, currently paused customers, estimated monthly revenue.\n   - Fast lookup by phone number or name search.\n   - Filter tabs: All, Active, Paused.\n4. **Pause & Resume Workflow**:\n   - 1-click pause with custom reasons.\n   - 1-click resume.\n   - Paused weekdays are not counted in monthly billing.\n5. **Fair Pro-Rated Month-End Billing**:\n   - Formula: $\\text{Daily Rate} = \\frac{\\text{Plan Price}}{\\text{Total Weekdays in Month}}$\n   - Final Bill: $\\text{Billed Amount} = \\text{Daily Rate} \\times \\text{Delivered Weekdays}$\n   - Transparent breakdown table showing total weekdays, paused days, delivered days, and final amount.\n","Description":"Root README documentation for decoupled frontend and backend","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/README.md","toolAction":"Updating README.md","toolSummary":"Update root README.md"}}]}

{"step_index":311,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T09:59:07Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":false,"Summary":"Walkthrough documenting the decoupling into separate backend and frontend folders with an Angular 18 application and Spring Boot REST API.","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Walkthrough: Decoupled Architecture with Angular Frontend\n\nThe project has been separated into two clean, independent directories inside `AurigaIT`:\n- [`backend/`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend): Spring Boot 3 REST API + Embedded H2 Database + CORS configuration.\n- [`frontend/`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend): Standalone Angular 18 Single-Page Application.\n\n---\n\n## 🏗️ What Was Created & Changed\n\n### 1. Spring Boot Backend (`backend/`)\n- Moved all Java source code, Maven wrapper, and database storage into `backend/`.\n- Cleared legacy static HTML/JS assets from `src/main/resources/static/`.\n- Configured **CORS** in [`SecurityConfig.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/config/SecurityConfig.java) to allow requests from Angular at `http://localhost:4200`.\n- Added `GET /api/subscriptions` to [`SubscriptionController.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/SubscriptionController.java) to enable filtering subscriptions by active/paused status.\n- Protected user passwords during JSON serialization with `@JsonProperty(access = WRITE_ONLY)` on [`User.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/entity/User.java).\n\n### 2. Angular 18 Frontend (`frontend/`)\nCreated standalone components with a clean design system:\n- **Landing Page** ([`landing.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/landing/landing.component.ts)):\n  - Hero section with live pro-rate billing calculation preview.\n  - Key features (pause/resume, fair billing, phone lookups, weekday meals).\n  - 3-step \"How It Works\" guide.\n  - Transparent pricing plans: Basic (₹2,000), Standard (₹3,000), and Premium (₹4,500).\n- **Authentication**:\n  - Sign In ([`login.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/login/login.component.ts)) with quick 1-click test credential autofill.\n  - Registration ([`register.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/register/register.component.ts)) supporting both Customer and Owner roles.\n  - JWT HTTP Interceptor ([`auth.interceptor.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/interceptors/auth.interceptor.ts)) and Route Guard ([`auth.guard.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/guards/auth.guard.ts)).\n- **Owner Dashboard** ([`dashboard.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/dashboard/dashboard.component.ts)):\n  - 4 Real-time metrics: Total Customers, Active Delivering, Currently Paused, Monthly Revenue.\n  - Instant Phone Lookup tool + text search.\n  - Subscription status tabs (All, Active, Paused).\n  - Subscription Pause Modal & 1-click Resume.\n  - Month-End Pro-Rated Bill Calculator modal with full breakdown.\n- **Global Styling** ([`styles.css`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/styles.css)): Custom typography, curated color palette, buttons, badges, modals, and responsive tables.\n\n---\n\n## 🧪 Verification Results\n\n| Target | Command | Result |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **Backend** | `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q` | ✅ **Exit code 0 (Build Success)** |\n| **Frontend** | `npm run build` | ✅ **Exit code 0 (Bundle generated in 7.6s)** |\n\n---\n\n## 🏃 Running the Application\n\n### Terminal 1 — Backend:\n```bash\ncd e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\backend\n.\\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n```\n\n### Terminal 2 — Frontend:\n```bash\ncd e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\frontend\nnpm start\n```\nThen visit **`http://localhost:4200`** in your browser.\n","Description":"Walkthrough for decoupled Angular and Spring Boot architecture","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\HP\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e\\walkthrough.md","toolAction":"Creating walkthrough artifact","toolSummary":"Create walkthrough document"}}]}

{"step_index":343,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:01:28Z","content":"To run the project, you will start the **Backend (Spring Boot)** and the **Frontend (Angular)** in two separate terminal windows:\n\n---\n\n### Step 1: Start the Backend (Spring Boot)\n\nOpen your first terminal and run:\n\n```powershell\ncd e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\backend\n.\\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n```\n\n* **API Server:** `http://localhost:8080/api`\n* **Swagger API Docs:** `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui/index.html`\n* **H2 Database Console:** `http://localhost:8080/h2-console`\n  - *JDBC URL:* `jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb`\n  - *User:* `sa`\n  - *Password:* *(leave blank)*\n\n> **Note:** On first startup, the backend automatically seeds the database with demo users, active/paused subscriptions, and test data.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Start the Frontend (Angular)\n\nOpen a second terminal and run:\n\n```powershell\ncd e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\frontend\nnpm start\n```\n\n* **Web Application:** `http://localhost:4200`\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Open in Browser & Test\n\n1. Navigate to **`http://localhost:4200`** in your browser.\n2. You will see the **Product Landing Page** with features, live pricing breakdown, and subscription tiers.\n3. Click **\"Owner Sign In\"** or navigate to `http://localhost:4200/login`.\n4. Use the pre-seeded owner credentials (or click the **\"⚡ Quick Test Account\"** button):\n   - **Email:** `owner@tiffin.com`\n   - **Password:** `password123`\n5. On the **Dashboard**, you can:\n   - View real-time active vs. paused customer counts.\n   - Look up customers by phone (e.g. `9876543211` for Anita Desai).\n   - Click **\"⏸️ Pause\"** or **\"▶️ Resume\"** on any customer subscription.\n   - Click **\"🧮 Monthly Invoices\"** to preview pro-rated billing for any month/year."}

{"step_index":388,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:24:16Z","content":"### Why that happened:\n\nIn the backend [`User.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/entity/User.java#L40-L42), the role enum is defined as:\n```java\npublic enum Role {\n    OWNER, CUSTOMER\n}\n```\nWhen logging in, the backend sends `role: \"OWNER\"`. \n\nHowever, in the navigation bar ([`navbar.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/navbar/navbar.component.ts)), the template previously only checked for the Spring Security authority format:\n```typescript\n// Previous check:\nuser.role === 'ROLE_OWNER' ? 'Owner' : 'Customer'\n```\nBecause `\"OWNER\"` did not strictly equal `\"ROLE_OWNER\"`, it evaluated to `false` and fell back to displaying **`Customer`**.\n\n---\n\n### Fix Applied:\n\nI updated [`navbar.component.ts`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/navbar/navbar.component.ts) to recognize both `\"OWNER\"` and `\"ROLE_OWNER\"`:\n\n```typescript\n<span class=\"role-tag\">{{ (user.role === 'OWNER' || user.role === 'ROLE_OWNER') ? 'Owner' : 'Customer' }}</span>\n```\n\nNow, when you are signed in as `owner@tiffin.com`, the badge correctly displays **Owner**.","thinking":"Awaiting the completion of `task-387` before proceeding with the next step. The outcome of this task is essential for the subsequent operations.\n\n\n"}

{"step_index":398,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:27:36Z","thinking":"The current user's email is obtainable from the authentication context. This email serves as the user's identifier within the system. Therefore, implementing endpoints for user-specific data like subscriptions and billing should be straightforward. Specifically, endpoints to retrieve subscriptions, billing information, and list tiffin services are possible with the current design.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":true,"Summary":"Implementation plan to create distinct layouts for Customer and Owner: showing available tiffin kitchens/services and personal subscriptions for customers, and business operations for owners.","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Distinct Layouts for Customer vs. Tiffin Owner\n\n## Summary of the Problem\nCurrently, when a user logs in as a **Customer** (e.g. `anita@example.com`), they see the exact same view as a **Tiffin Owner** (business revenue metrics, customer search by phone, and all customer subscriptions).\nA customer should instead see a **Customer Portal**:\n1. **Available Tiffin Services / Kitchen Owners**: Browse available tiffin kitchens, view their menu plans (Basic, Standard, Premium), and subscribe.\n2. **My Tiffin Subscription**: View current active plan, delivery schedule (Mon–Fri), live status (Delivering vs. Paused), 1-click pause/resume, and personal pro-rated bill history.\n\n---\n\n## User Review Required\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> - **Owner View**: Remains focused on kitchen operations (today's deliveries, look up customers by phone, managing pauses, calculating month-end pro-rated bills).\n> - **Customer View**: Replaced with a customer experience (Available Tiffin Providers list, My Current Subscription card with pause/resume controls, and My Invoices).\n\n---\n\n## Proposed Changes\n\n### 1. Spring Boot Backend (`backend/`)\n\n#### [NEW / MODIFY] [CustomerController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/CustomerController.java) or [OwnerController.java]\n- Add endpoint `GET /api/tiffin-services`:\n  - Returns list of available registered tiffin owners/kitchens (`id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`).\n  - Open to all authenticated users.\n\n#### [MODIFY] [SubscriptionController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/SubscriptionController.java)\n- Add endpoint `GET /api/subscriptions/my`:\n  - Retrieves subscriptions belonging to the currently authenticated user based on JWT security context.\n\n#### [MODIFY] [BillingController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/BillingController.java)\n- Add endpoint `GET /api/billing/my`:\n  - Retrieves invoices/bills belonging to the currently authenticated user.\n\n---\n\n### 2. Angular Frontend (`frontend/`)\n\n#### [MODIFY] [tiffin.service.ts](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/services/tiffin.service.ts)\n- Add `getAvailableTiffinServices()` -> `/api/tiffin-services`\n- Add `getMySubscriptions()` -> `/api/subscriptions/my`\n- Add `getMyInvoices()` -> `/api/billing/my`\n\n#### [MODIFY] [dashboard.component.ts](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/dashboard/dashboard.component.ts)\n- Detect user role (`isOwner` vs `isCustomer`).\n- Render role-specific layouts:\n  - **Owner Layout**:\n    - Metric cards (active meals today, total customers, revenue).\n    - Customer search by phone.\n    - Full customer subscriptions table with owner controls.\n    - Month-end bulk invoice calculator.\n  - **Customer Layout**:\n    - **\"My Active Subscription\" Card**: Current plan, delivery status badge, delivery weekdays (Mon–Fri), pause/resume buttons, and billing breakdown.\n    - **\"Available Tiffin Kitchens\" Directory**: Displays registered tiffin services with contact details, meal plans (Basic, Standard, Premium), and \"Subscribe\" button.\n    - **\"My Invoices & Receipts\" History**: Transparent view of their pro-rated charges showing delivered vs. paused days.\n\n---\n\n## Verification Plan\n\n### Automated Verification\n- Backend compile: `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q`\n- Frontend build: `npm run build`\n\n### Manual Verification\n1. Log in as **Owner** (`owner@tiffin.com` / `password123`):\n   - Verify owner dashboard with business metrics and customer phone search.\n2. Log in as **Customer** (`anita@example.com` / `password123`):\n   - Verify customer dashboard shows:\n     - Anita's current subscription (`PREMIUM`, currently `PAUSED`).\n     - Available Tiffin Providers list with kitchen details.\n     - Resume button to unpause lunch deliveries.\n     - Pro-rated bill calculation for her account.\n","Description":"Plan for separating Customer and Owner layouts with Available Tiffin Services directory","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\HP\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e\\implementation_plan.md","toolAction":"Creating implementation plan","toolSummary":"Create plan for Customer vs Owner layout"}}]}

(!this.searchPhone.trim()) {\n      this.lookupResult = null;\n      return;\n    }\n    this.tiffinService.searchByPhone(this.searchPhone.trim()).subscribe({\n      next: (customer) => {\n        this.lookupResult = customer;\n        this.searchQuery = customer.phone;\n        this.applyLocalFilter();\n      },\n      error: () => {\n        this.showAlert(`No customer found with phone: ${this.searchPhone}`, 'error');\n        this.lookupResult = null;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ── Customer Methods ──\n\n  loadCustomerData(): void {\n    this.tiffinService.getMySubscriptions().subscribe({\n      next: (subs) => {\n        // Look for active or paused subscription\n        const current = subs.find(s => s.status === 'ACTIVE' || s.status === 'PAUSED');\n        this.mySubscription = current || (subs.length > 0 ? subs[0] : null);\n      },\n      error: (err) => console.error('Error fetching my subscriptions', err)\n    });\n\n    this.tiffinService.getMyInvoices().subscribe({\n      next: (res) => {\n        this.myInvoices = res.content || [];\n      },\n      error: (err) => console.error('Error fetching my invoices', err)\n    });\n  }\n\n  loadTiffinProviders(): void {\n    this.tiffinService.getAvailableTiffinServices().subscribe({\n      next: (providers) => {\n        this.tiffinProviders = providers;\n      },\n      error: (err) => console.error('Error fetching tiffin providers', err)\n    });\n  }\n\n  subscribeToKitchen(provider: User): void {\n    if (this.mySubscription && this.mySubscription.status !== 'CANCELLED') {\n      this.showAlert(`You already have an active subscription (${this.mySubscription.planName}). Please cancel it before subscribing to a new kitchen.`, 'error');\n      return;\n    }\n    this.newSubCustomerId = this.currentUser?.userId || this.currentUser?.id;\n    this.showNewSubModal = true;\n  }\n\n  // ── Shared Pause & Resume ──\n\n  openPauseModal(sub: any): void {\n    this.targetSubscription = sub;\n    this.pauseReason = '';\n    this.showPauseModal = true;\n  }\n\n  confirmPause(): void {\n    if (!this.targetSubscription) return;\n    this.tiffinService.pauseSubscription(this.targetSubscription.id, this.pauseReason).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showPauseModal = false;\n        this.showAlert('Deliveries paused successfully. You will not be charged for paused weekdays.');\n        if (this.isOwner) {\n          this.loadSubscriptions();\n          this.loadStats();\n        } else {\n          this.loadCustomerData();\n        }\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to pause subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  resumeSubscription(sub: any): void {\n    this.tiffinService.resumeSubscription(sub.id).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showAlert('Deliveries resumed successfully! Meals scheduled for upcoming weekdays.');\n        if (this.isOwner) {\n          this.loadSubscriptions();\n          this.loadStats();\n        } else {\n          this.loadCustomerData();\n        }\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to resume subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ── Billing (Owner) ──\n\n  openBillingModal(): void {\n    this.showBillingModal = true;\n    this.generateInvoices();\n  }\n\n  openSubBilling(sub: any): void {\n    this.showBillingModal = true;\n    this.generateInvoices();\n  }\n\n  generateInvoices(): void {\n    this.calculatingBill = true;\n    this.tiffinService.generateInvoices(this.billingMonth, this.billingYear).subscribe({\n      next: (res) => {\n        this.invoices = res;\n        this.calculatingBill = false;\n      },\n      error: (err) => {\n        this.calculatingBill = false;\n        this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Error generating invoices', 'error');\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ── New Subscription ──\n\n  openNewSubModal(): void {\n    this.showNewSubModal = true;\n  }\n\n  createSubscription(): void {\n    const custId = this.isOwner ? this.newSubCustomerId : (this.currentUser?.userId || this.currentUser?.id);\n    if (!custId) {\n      this.showAlert('Please select a customer', 'error');\n      return;\n    }\n    this.tiffinService.createSubscription({\n      customerId: custId,\n      planName: this.newSubPlan\n    }).subscribe({\n      next: () => {\n        this.showNewSubModal = false;\n        this.showAlert('Subscription created successfully!');\n        if (this.isOwner) {\n          this.loadSubscriptions();\n          this.loadStats();\n        } else {\n          this.loadCustomerData();\n        }\n      },\n      error: (err) => this.showAlert(err.error?.message || 'Failed to create subscription', 'error')\n    });\n  }\n\n  private showAlert(msg: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success'): void {\n    this.alertMessage = msg;\n    this.alertType = type;\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      if (this.alertMessage === msg) {\n        this.alertMessage = '';\n      }\n    }, 4000);\n  }\n}\n","Description":"DashboardComponent with separated Customer View (available tiffin kitchens directory, personal subscription, pause/resume) and Owner View (business metrics, customer phone lookup, all subscriptions)","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/frontend/src/app/components/dashboard/dashboard.component.ts","toolAction":"Updating DashboardComponent with separate Customer and Owner layouts","toolSummary":"Update Dashboard component"}}]}

{"step_index":433,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:30:15Z","thinking":"Task-432 has completed.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":false,"Summary":"Walkthrough documenting the separate layouts for Customer vs. Owner, including Available Tiffin Kitchens directory, personal subscription management, and backend endpoints.","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Walkthrough: Separate Customer & Owner Experiences\n\nThe dashboard and portals have been separated into two distinct user experiences based on the authenticated user's role:\n\n---\n\n## 🎨 1. Customer Experience (`ROLE_CUSTOMER`)\n\nWhen a customer logs in (e.g. `anita@example.com` / `password123`):\n1. **My Lunch Subscription Card**:\n   - Displays the customer's current meal plan (e.g. `PREMIUM Tiffin Plan` - ₹4,500/mo).\n   - Live delivery badge:\n     - `🟢 Active & Delivering` (Delivering weekdays Mon–Fri).\n     - `⏸️ Currently Paused` (deliveries on hold, with date and reason).\n   - Direct Customer Controls:\n     - **\"⏸️ Pause Deliveries\"** button to pause upcoming meals with optional reason.\n     - **\"▶️ Resume Deliveries\"** button to restart daily lunch deliveries.\n2. **Available Tiffin Services & Kitchens Directory**:\n   - Browses verified registered tiffin kitchen owners fetched from `/api/tiffin-services`.\n   - Each kitchen card shows:\n     - Kitchen Name & Owner (e.g. `Owner's Kitchen`).\n     - Contact: 📞 Phone & ✉️ Email.\n     - Available Menu Tiers:\n       - **Basic Tiffin**: 4 Rotis, Seasonal Sabzi (₹2,000/mo).\n       - **Standard Tiffin**: Rotis, Sabzi, Dal, Rice & Salad (₹3,000/mo).\n       - **Premium Feast**: Rotis, 2 Sabzis, Dal, Rice & Dessert (₹4,500/mo).\n     - **\"Subscribe to this Kitchen\"** button to start a subscription.\n3. **My Invoices & Meal Statement**:\n   - Transparent table showing monthly billing history: Total Weekdays in Month, Paused Days, Delivered Days, and Pro-Rated Billed Amount.\n\n---\n\n## 🧑‍🍳 2. Owner Experience (`ROLE_OWNER`)\n\nWhen an owner logs in (e.g. `owner@tiffin.com` / `password123`):\n1. **Business Metrics**:\n   - Total registered customers.\n   - Active meals delivering today.\n   - Currently paused subscriptions.\n   - Estimated monthly revenue.\n2. **Customer Lookup by Phone**:\n   - Instant phone search (e.g. `9876543211` for Anita Desai).\n   - Filter tabs: All, Active, Paused.\n3. **Customer Subscriptions Table**:\n   - All customer subscriptions with plan type, delivery status, and pause details.\n   - Owner actions to pause/resume or review customer bills.\n4. **Month-End Billing Calculator**:\n   - Batch invoice calculation for all customers.\n   - Full pro-rating breakdown: $\\text{Daily Rate} \\times \\text{Delivered Days}$.\n\n---\n\n## ⚙️ Backend Endpoints Added\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Access | Purpose |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| `GET` | `/api/tiffin-services` | Authenticated | Lists registered tiffin providers / kitchen owners |\n| `GET` | `/api/subscriptions/my` | Authenticated | Retrieves current logged-in customer's subscription |\n| `GET` | `/api/billing/my` | Authenticated | Retrieves current logged-in customer's invoices |\n\n---\n\n## 🧪 Verification\n\n- **Backend compilation**: `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q` ➔ **Exit code 0**\n- **Frontend build**: `npm run build` ➔ **Exit code 0 (Bundle generated in 10.2s)**\n","Description":"Walkthrough for separate Customer and Owner layouts","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:\\Users\\HP\\.gemini\\antigravity-ide\\brain\\23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e\\walkthrough.md","toolAction":"Updating walkthrough artifact","toolSummary":"Update walkthrough document"}}]}

{"step_index":435,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:30:24Z","content":"I have implemented separate, dedicated layouts for **Customers** and **Tiffin Owners**:\n\n---\n\n### 1. 🍱 Customer Portal (When a Customer Logs In)\nWhen customers like **Anita Desai** (`anita@example.com`) log in, they now see:\n\n1. **My Lunch Subscription Card**:\n   - Shows their active plan (e.g. `PREMIUM Tiffin Plan` - ₹4,500/mo) and schedule (`Mon–Fri Weekdays`).\n   - Live delivery status badge: `🟢 Active & Delivering` or `⏸️ Currently Paused`.\n   - Direct self-service action buttons: **\"⏸️ Pause Deliveries\"** (to pause upcoming days) and **\"▶️ Resume Deliveries\"**.\n2. **Available Tiffin Services & Kitchens Directory**:\n   - Displays all registered home-style tiffin kitchens fetched dynamically from `/api/tiffin-services`.\n   - Displays kitchen name, chef contact (📞 Phone, ✉️ Email), and menu tiers (**Basic**, **Standard**, and **Premium**).\n   - Includes a **\"Subscribe to this Kitchen\"** button.\n3. **My Invoices & Meal Statement**:\n   - Shows their personal pro-rated billing history: Total Weekdays in Month, Paused Weekdays, Delivered Days, and Final Billed Amount.\n\n---\n\n### 2. 🧑‍🍳 Owner Operations Portal (When an Owner Logs In)\nWhen the business owner (`owner@tiffin.com`) logs in:\n- Shows the full business dashboard:\n  - Real-time kitchen metrics (meals delivering today, total customers, paused customers, revenue).\n  - Instant phone number search lookup.\n  - Active vs. Paused filter tabs.\n  - Full customer subscriptions table with administrative pause/resume controls.\n  - Month-end bulk pro-rated bill generator.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Backend Endpoints Added\n- **`GET /api/tiffin-services`**: Returns the list of registered tiffin providers / kitchen owners.\n- **`GET /api/subscriptions/my`**: Returns the current logged-in customer's subscription.\n- **`GET /api/billing/my`**: Returns the current logged-in customer's billing invoices.\n\n---\n\n### Verification\n- **Backend**: `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q` succeeded with **0 errors**.\n- **Frontend**: `npm run build` completed with **0 errors**."}

Checks if the date is a weekday (Monday–Friday). If weekend, no delivery notifications.\n  - Finds all subscriptions active on that date (started $\\le$ date, not cancelled, and **not paused** on that date).\n  - For each active subscription, generates a notification in the outbox:\n    - Message: `\"Hello [Customer Name], your [Plan] lunch delivery is scheduled for today ([Date]). Enjoy your meal!\"`\n\n#### [NEW] [ClockController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/ClockController.java) & [OutboxController.java]\n- Mappings for both root and `/api`:\n  - `POST /clock` and `POST /api/clock`: Accepts optional `{ \"date\": \"2026-09-17\" }`, triggers notification processing, returns summary.\n  - `GET /outbox` and `GET /api/outbox`: Returns list of outbox notifications (graded by evaluation bot).\n  - `DELETE /outbox` / `POST /outbox/clear`: Resets outbox for testing.\n\n---\n\n### Level 2 — T6: Subscription Transfer Mid-Cycle with Split Billing\n\n#### [NEW] [SubscriptionTransfer.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/entity/SubscriptionTransfer.java)\n- Entity tracking transfer lifecycle:\n  - `id`: Long\n  - `originalSubscription`: Subscription (Customer A)\n  - `transferredSubscription`: Subscription (Customer B)\n  - `fromCustomer`: User (Customer A)\n  - `toCustomer`: User (Customer B)\n  - `transferDate`: LocalDate\n  - `reason`: String\n\n#### [MODIFY] [SubscriptionService.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/SubscriptionService.java) & [SubscriptionController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/SubscriptionController.java)\n- `POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/transfer`:\n  - Closes Customer A's active period at `transferDate - 1 day` (or marks transferred).\n  - Creates Customer B's subscription carrying over the exact plan and cycle starting on `transferDate`.\n  - Records the transfer event.\n\n#### [MODIFY] [BillingService.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/BillingService.java)\n- Update pro-rated calculation to handle transferred subscriptions:\n  - Customer A is billed strictly for weekdays delivered between cycle start and `transferDate - 1`.\n  - Customer B is billed strictly for weekdays delivered between `transferDate` and cycle end.\n  - Pauses by Customer A only deduct from Customer A's bill; pauses by Customer B only deduct from Customer B's bill.\n\n---\n\n### Level 3 — T4: Messy Customer Data Import\n\n#### [NEW] [DataImportService.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/DataImportService.java)\n- Multi-format parser (JSON payload or CSV):\n  - **Phone Normalization**: Strips `+91`, `()`, `-`, spaces. Validates 10-digit format.\n  - **Flexible Date Parsing**: Handles `yyyy-MM-dd`, `dd/MM/yyyy`, `MM/dd/yyyy`, `dd-MM-yyyy`, `d-MMM-yyyy`.\n  - **Deduplication**: Detects duplicates within the import batch or matching existing users in DB.\n  - **Validation & Rejection**: Rejects records with missing/invalid phones, malformed emails, or unparseable dates with specific reason.\n- Returns comprehensive report:\n  ```json\n  {\n    \"totalRecords\": 10,\n    \"importedCount\": 6,\n    \"dedupedCount\": 2,\n    \"rejectedCount\": 2,\n    \"imported\": [ ... ],\n    \"deduped\": [ ... ],\n    \"rejected\": [ { \"row\": 3, \"data\": { ... }, \"reason\": \"Invalid phone format\" } ]\n  }\n  ```\n\n#### [NEW] [DataImportController.java](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/DataImportController.java)\n- `POST /api/customers/import`: Accepts JSON or multipart CSV file upload.\n\n---\n\n### Frontend UI Additions (`frontend/`)\n\n1. **Clock & Notification Outbox Viewer**:\n   - Simulation widget in Owner Dashboard to trigger `POST /clock` for any date.\n   - Outbox drawer/modal showing queued notifications sent today.\n2. **Subscription Transfer Modal**:\n   - \"Transfer Subscription\" button on any active subscription in Owner table.\n   - Select or type new customer details and effective transfer date.\n3. **Messy Data Import UI**:\n   - \"Import Customers\" button with sample messy data templates (JSON/CSV).\n   - Results view displaying the `{ imported, deduped, rejected }` breakdown with color-coded chips.\n\n---\n\n## Verification Plan\n\n### Automated Tests / API Tests\n1. **Level 1 (T1)**:\n   - `POST /clock` with a weekday date (e.g. `2026-09-08`).\n   - Query `GET /outbox`:\n     - Anita Desai (paused) must **NOT** receive a notification.\n     - Priya Sharma & Rahul Verma (active) must receive notifications.\n     - Total recipients match active delivery count.\n   - `POST /clock` with a weekend (e.g. `2026-09-12` Saturday) -> Outbox receives 0 new notifications.\n2. **Level 2 (T6)**:\n   - Transfer a Standard plan subscription from Customer A to Customer B on Sept 15.\n   - Generate bills for September:\n     - Customer A is billed for 10 weekdays (Sept 1–14).\n     - Customer B is billed for 12 weekdays (Sept 15–30).\n     - Total billed equals full monthly plan (or pro-rated if pauses exist).\n3. **Level 3 (T4)**:\n   - {"step_index":491,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:38:09Z","content":"I have created the [Implementation Plan](file:///C:/Users/HP/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e/implementation_plan.md) covering all three evaluation twists:\n\n### 1. **Level 1 — T1 (integrate): Notification Service via `POST /clock` & `GET /outbox`**\n- Morning clock trigger (`POST /clock` and `POST /api/clock` with optional date).\n- Automatically identifies active, non-paused weekday deliveries and queues notifications into the outbox.\n- Publicly accessible `GET /outbox` (and `GET /api/outbox`) endpoint for grading bots.\n\n### 2. **Level 2 — T6 (lifecycle): Subscription Transfer Mid-Cycle with Split Billing**\n- `POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/transfer` transfers an active subscription mid-cycle to a new customer.\n- The plan type and monthly cycle carry over seamlessly.\n- Month-end billing splits accurately: Customer A is billed only for weekdays served before transfer; Customer B is billed only for weekdays served from the transfer date onward.\n\n### 3. **Level 3 — T4 (messy data): Messy Customer List Import**\n- `POST /api/customers/import` accepts messy customer lists (JSON or CSV).\n- Handles phone normalization (`+91`, spaces, dashes, parentheses), flexible multi-format date parsing (`dd/MM/yyyy`, `yyyy-MM-dd`, `d-MMM-yyyy`), and blank handling.\n- Returns a structured `{ imported, deduped, rejected }` report with counts and specific rejection reasons.\n\nPlease review the plan and confirm to begin implementation!"}

{"step_index":504,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:40:45Z","thinking":"The task requires handling a POST request to `/clock` with a date to determine weekday status. The logic needs to verify if the provided date falls on a weekday (Monday to Friday). If the date is on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday), the service should return a specific message and indicate no messages are generated. Otherwise, process the request for a weekday.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.service;\n\nimport com.tiffin.entity.OutboxMessage;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.PausePeriod;\nimport com.tiffin.entity.Subscription;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.OutboxMessageRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.PausePeriodRepository;\nimport com.tiffin.repository.SubscriptionRepository;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Service;\nimport org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;\n\nimport java.time.DayOfWeek;\nimport java.time.LocalDate;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n@Service\npublic class ClockService {\n\n    private final SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository;\n    private final PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository;\n    private final OutboxMessageRepository outboxRepository;\n\n    public ClockService(SubscriptionRepository subscriptionRepository,\n                        PausePeriodRepository pauseRepository,\n                        OutboxMessageRepository outboxRepository) {\n        this.subscriptionRepository = subscriptionRepository;\n        this.pauseRepository = pauseRepository;\n        this.outboxRepository = outboxRepository;\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public Map<String, Object> tickClock(LocalDate date) {\n        if (date == null) {\n            date = LocalDate.now();\n        }\n\n        DayOfWeek dow = date.getDayOfWeek();\n        boolean isWeekday = (dow != DayOfWeek.SATURDAY && dow != DayOfWeek.SUNDAY);\n\n        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        result.put(\"clockDate\", date.toString());\n        result.put(\"dayOfWeek\", dow.name());\n        result.put(\"isWeekday\", isWeekday);\n\n        if (!isWeekday) {\n            result.put(\"message\", \"Weekend (\" + dow.name() + \"). No weekday lunch deliveries scheduled today.\");\n            result.put(\"notifiedCount\", 0);\n            result.put(\"notifications\", Collections.emptyList());\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        List<Subscription> activeOrPausedSubs = subscriptionRepository.findAllActiveOrPaused();\n        List<OutboxMessage> createdNotifications = new ArrayList<>();\n        int pausedCount = 0;\n\n        for (Subscription sub : activeOrPausedSubs) {\n            // Check start and end dates\n            if (sub.getStartDate().isAfter(date)) continue;\n            if (sub.getEndDate() != null && sub.getEndDate().isBefore(date)) continue;\n            if (sub.getStatus() == Subscription.Status.CANCELLED) continue;\n\n            // Check if customer is paused on this date\n            List<PausePeriod> pauses = pauseRepository.findOverlappingPauses(sub.getId(), date, date);\n            boolean isPausedToday = pauses.stream().anyMatch(p -> p.coversDate(date));\n\n            if (isPausedToday) {\n                pausedCount++;\n                continue; // Do NOT notify paused customers\n            }\n\n            // Customer is due a delivery today! Notify via Outbox\n            String msg = \"Hello \" + sub.getCustomer().getName() + \", your \" + sub.getPlanName() +\n                    \" lunch delivery is scheduled for today (\" + date + \"). Enjoy your meal!\";\n\n            OutboxMessage outboxMsg = new OutboxMessage(\n                    sub.getCustomer().getId(),\n                    sub.getCustomer().getName(),\n                    sub.getCustomer().getPhone(),\n                    sub.getCustomer().getEmail(),\n                    sub.getPlanName().name(),\n                    date,\n                    msg\n            );\n\n            outboxRepository.save(outboxMsg);\n            createdNotifications.add(outboxMsg);\n        }\n\n        result.put(\"totalEligibleSubscriptions\", activeOrPausedSubs.size());\n        result.put(\"pausedCount\", pausedCount);\n        result.put(\"notifiedCount\", createdNotifications.size());\n        result.put(\"message\", \"Clock tick processed: \" + createdNotifications.size() + \" customers notified for delivery.\");\n        result.put(\"notifications\", createdNotifications);\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    public List<OutboxMessage> getOutboxMessages(LocalDate date) {\n        if (date != null) {\n            return outboxRepository.findByDeliveryDateOrderByCreatedAtDesc(date);\n        }\n        return outboxRepository.findAllByOrderByCreatedAtDesc();\n    }\n\n    @Transactional\n    public void clearOutbox() {\n        outboxRepository.deleteAll();\n    }\n}\n","Description":"ClockService processing morning deliveries, active/paused checks, and outbox messages","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/ClockService.java","toolAction":"Creating ClockService","toolSummary":"Create ClockService"}}]}

request.getTransferDate() : LocalDate.now();\n\n        if (transferDate.isBefore(sourceSub.getStartDate())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Transfer date (\" + transferDate +\n                    \") cannot be before subscription start date (\" + sourceSub.getStartDate() + \")\");\n        }\n\n        User targetCustomer;\n        if (request != null && request.getTargetCustomerId() != null) {\n            targetCustomer = userRepository.findById(request.getTargetCustomerId())\n                    .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Target customer not found: \" + request.getTargetCustomerId()));\n        } else if (request != null && request.getTargetPhone() != null && !request.getTargetPhone().isBlank()) {\n            targetCustomer = userRepository.findByPhone(request.getTargetPhone().trim())\n                    .orElseThrow(() -> new ResourceNotFoundException(\"Target customer with phone \" + request.getTargetPhone() + \" not found.\"));\n        } else {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Target customer ID or phone is required for transfer\");\n        }\n\n        if (targetCustomer.getId().equals(sourceSub.getCustomer().getId())) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Cannot transfer subscription to the same customer\");\n        }\n\n        // Close source subscription on day before transferDate\n        LocalDate sourceEndDate = transferDate.isAfter(sourceSub.getStartDate()) ? transferDate.minusDays(1) : sourceSub.getStartDate();\n        sourceSub.setEndDate(sourceEndDate);\n        sourceSub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.CANCELLED);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(sourceSub);\n\n        // Close any active pause extending past transfer\n        List<PausePeriod> pauses = pauseRepository.findBySubscriptionIdOrderByStartDateDesc(sourceSub.getId());\n        for (PausePeriod p : pauses) {\n            if (p.isActive()) {\n                p.setActive(false);\n                p.setResumedAt(LocalDateTime.now());\n                if (p.getEndDate() == null || p.getEndDate().isAfter(sourceEndDate)) {\n                    p.setEndDate(sourceEndDate);\n                }\n                pauseRepository.save(p);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Create new subscription for target customer carrying over plan and price\n        Subscription newSub = new Subscription();\n        newSub.setCustomer(targetCustomer);\n        newSub.setPlanName(sourceSub.getPlanName());\n        newSub.setPlanPrice(sourceSub.getPlanPrice());\n        newSub.setStartDate(transferDate);\n        newSub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n        subscriptionRepository.save(newSub);\n\n        // Record transfer\n        SubscriptionTransfer transfer = new SubscriptionTransfer(\n                sourceSub.getId(),\n                newSub.getId(),\n                sourceSub.getCustomer().getId(),\n                sourceSub.getCustomer().getName(),\n                targetCustomer.getId(),\n                targetCustomer.getName(),\n                transferDate,\n                (request != null && request.getReason() != null) ? request.getReason() : \"Mid-cycle subscription transfer\"\n        );\n        transferRepository.save(transfer);\n\n        Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        res.put(\"message\", \"Subscription successfully transferred from \" + sourceSub.getCustomer().getName() + \" to \" + targetCustomer.getName());\n        res.put(\"transferId\", transfer.getId());\n        res.put(\"transferDate\", transferDate.toString());\n        res.put(\"originalSubscriptionId\", sourceSub.getId());\n        res.put(\"newSubscriptionId\", newSub.getId());\n        res.put(\"fromCustomer\", sourceSub.getCustomer().getName());\n        res.put(\"toCustomer\", targetCustomer.getName());\n        res.put(\"planName\", newSub.getPlanName().name());\n        res.put(\"planPrice\", newSub.getPlanPrice());\n\n        return res;\n    }\n\n    private BigDecimal getDefaultPrice(Subscription.PlanName plan) {","StartLine":100,"TargetContent":"    public List<Subscription> getAll(Subscription.Status status) {\n        if (status != null) {\n            return subscriptionRepository.findByStatus(status);\n        }\n        return subscriptionRepository.findAllActiveOrPaused();\n    }\n\n    private BigDecimal getDefaultPrice(Subscription.PlanName plan) {","TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/SubscriptionService.java","toolAction":"Adding transferSubscription method to SubscriptionService","toolSummary":"Add transferSubscription in SubscriptionService"}}]}

rowIndex++;\n            String rawName = getString(record, \"name\", \"customerName\", \"Name\");\n            String rawPhone = getString(record, \"phone\", \"phoneNumber\", \"mobile\", Supported: yyyy-MM-dd, dd/MM/yyyy, dd-MMM-yyyy\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n            if (parsedDate == null) {\n                parsedDate = LocalDate.now();\n            }\n\n            // 5. Check for Duplicate in DB\n            Optional<User> existingUserOpt = userRepository.findByPhone(normalizedPhone);\n            if (existingUserOpt.isPresent()) {\n                User existingUser = existingUserOpt.get();\n                // Check if user has active subscription\n                List<Subscription> activeSubs = subscriptionRepository\n                        .findByCustomerIdAndStatus(existingUser.getId(), Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n                if (!activeSubs.isEmpty()) {\n                    deduped.add(Map.of(\n                            \"row\", rowIndex,\n                            \"customerId\", existingUser.getId(),\n                            \"name\", existingUser.getName(),\n                            \"phone\", normalizedPhone,\n                            \"reason\", \"Customer already exists in database with active subscription\"\n                    ));\n                    continue;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // 7. Create Subscription\n            Subscription sub = new Subscription();\n            sub.setCustomer(user);\n            sub.setPlanName(plan);\n            sub.setPlanPrice(getDefaultPrice(plan));\n            sub.setStartDate(parsedDate);\n            sub.setStatus(Subscription.Status.ACTIVE);\n            subscriptionRepository.save(sub);\n\n            Map<String, Object> importedItem = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            importedItem.put(\"row\", rowIndex);\n            importedItem.put(\"subscriptionId\", sub.getId());\n            importedItem.put(\"customerId\", user.getId());\n            importedItem.put(\"name\", user.getName());\n            importedItem.put(\"phone\", user.getPhone());\n            importedItem.put(\"plan\", plan.name());\n            importedItem.put(\"startDate\", parsedDate.toString());\n            imported.add(importedItem);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        report.put(\"totalRecords\", records.size());\n        report.put(\"importedCount\", imported.size());\n        report.put(\"dedupedCount\", deduped.size());\n        report.put(\"rejectedCount\", rejected.size());\n        report.put(\"imported\", imported);\n        report.put(\"deduped\", deduped);\n        report.put(\"rejected\", rejected);\n\n        return report;\n    }\n\n    // ── Helper parsing methods ──\n\n    private String normalizePhone(String raw) {\n        if (raw == null) return null;\n        // Strip everything except digits\n        String digits = raw.replaceAll(\"[^0-9]\", \"\");\n        // If 12 digits starting with 91 (e.g. +91 9876543210)\n        if (digits.length() == 12 && digits.startsWith(\"91\")) {\n            digits =  if (digits.length() == 10) {\n            return digits;\n        }\n        return null; // Invalid length\n    }\n\n    private LocalDate parseFlexibleDate(String raw) {\n        if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty()) return null;\n        String clean = raw.trim();\n        for (DateTimeFormatter fmt : DATE_FORMATTERS) {\n            try {\n                return LocalDate.parse(clean, fmt);\n            } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {}\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private Subscription.PlanName parsePlan(String raw) {\n        if (raw == null) return  return map.get(k).toString();\n            }\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> buildRejectEntry(int row, Map<String, Object> record, String reason) {\n {"step_index":542,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:42:57Z","thinking":"Creating `DataImportController.java` is the next step, aiming to handle data imports. The controller needs to support two endpoints: one at `/api/customers/import` for JSON data, and another at `/import`, which should accept both JSON and CSV data. Considering direct access to `/import` enhances flexibility.\n\n\n","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"package com.tiffin.controller;\n\nimport com.tiffin.service.DataImportService;\nimport org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;\nimport org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;\n\nimport java.io.BufferedReader;\nimport java.io.InputStreamReader;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.*;\n\n@RestController\npublic class DataImportController {\n\n    private final DataImportService dataImportService;\n\n    public DataImportController(DataImportService dataImportService) {\n        this.dataImportService = dataImportService;\n    }\n\n    // ── JSON Import ──\n    @PostMapping({\"/api/customers/import\", \"/import\"})\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> importCustomersJson(\n            @RequestBody List<Map<String, Object>> records) {\n        Map<String, Object> report = dataImportService.importCustomerList(records);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(report);\n    }\n\n    // ── CSV File / Multipart Import ──\n    @PostMapping({\"/api/customers/import-csv\", \"/import-csv\"})\n    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> importCustomersCsv(\n            @RequestParam(\"file\") MultipartFile file) throws Exception {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> records = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(\n                new InputStreamReader(file.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {\n            String headerLine = reader.readLine();\n            if (headerLine != null) {\n                String[] headers = headerLine.split(\",\");\n                for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {\n                    headers[i] = headers[i].trim().replaceAll(\"^\\\"|\\\"$\", \"\");\n                }\n\n                String line;\n                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {\n                    if (line.trim().isEmpty()) continue;\n                    String[] values = line.split(\",\", -1);\n                    Map<String, Object> record = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {\n                        String val = (i < values.length) ? values[i].trim().replaceAll(\"^\\\"|\\\"$\", \"\") : \"\";\n                        record.put(headers[i], val);\n                    }\n                    records.add(record);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> report = dataImportService.importCustomerList(records);\n        return ResponseEntity.ok(report);\n    }\n}\n","Description":"Controller handling JSON and CSV customer data imports with validation and report generation","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/controller/DataImportController.java","toolAction":"Creating DataImportController","toolSummary":"Create DataImportController"}}]}

Please note that any changes targeting the original code should remove the line number, colon, and leading space.\n1: # Walkthrough: Separate Customer & Owner Experiences\n2: \n3: The dashboard and portals have been separated into two distinct user experiences based on the authenticated user's role:\n4: \n5: ---\n6: \n7: ## 🎨 1. Customer Experience (`ROLE_CUSTOMER`)\n8: \n9: When a customer logs in (e.g. `anita@example.com` / `password123`):\n10: 1. **My Lunch Subscription Card**:\n11:    - Displays the customer's current meal plan (e.g. `PREMIUM Tiffin Plan` - ₹4,500/mo).\n12:    - Live delivery badge:\n13:      - `🟢 Active & Delivering` (Delivering weekdays Mon–Fri).\n14:      - `⏸️ Currently Paused` (deliveries on hold, with date and reason).\n15:    - Direct Customer Controls:\n16:      - **\"⏸️ Pause Deliveries\"** button to pause upcoming meals with optional reason.\n17:      - **\"▶️ Resume Deliveries\"** button to restart daily lunch deliveries.\n18: 2. **Available Tiffin Services & Kitchens Directory**:\n19:    - Browses verified registered tiffin kitchen owners fetched from `/api/tiffin-services`.\n20:    - Each kitchen card shows:\n21:      - Kitchen Name & Owner (e.g. `Owner's Kitchen`).\n22:      - Contact: 📞 Phone & ✉️ Email.\n23:      - Available Menu Tiers:\n24:        - **Basic Tiffin**: 4 Rotis, Seasonal Sabzi (₹2,000/mo).\n25:        - **Standard Tiffin**: Rotis, Sabzi, Dal, Rice & Salad (₹3,000/mo).\n26:        - **Premium Feast**: Rotis, 2 Sabzis, Dal, Rice & Dessert (₹4,500/mo).\n27:      - **\"Subscribe to this Kitchen\"** button to start a subscription.\n28: 3. **My Invoices & Meal Statement**:\n29:    - Transparent table showing monthly billing history: Total Weekdays in Month, Paused Days, Delivered Days, and Pro-Rated Billed Amount.\n30: \n31: ---\n32: \n33: ## 🧑‍🍳 2. Owner Experience (`ROLE_OWNER`)\n34: \n35: When an owner logs in (e.g. `owner@tiffin.com` / `password123`):\n36: 1. **Business Metrics**:\n37:    - Total registered customers.\n38:    - Active meals delivering today.\n39:    - Currently paused subscriptions.\n40:    - Estimated monthly revenue.\n41: 2. **Customer Lookup by Phone**:\n42:    - Instant phone search (e.g. `9876543211` for Anita Desai).\n43:    - Filter tabs: All, Active, Paused.\n44: 3. **Customer Subscriptions Table**:\n45:    - All customer subscriptions with plan type, delivery status, and pause details.\n46:    - Owner actions to pause/resume or review customer bills.\n47: 4. **Month-End Billing Calculator**:\n48:    - Batch invoice calculation for all customers.\n49:    - Full pro-rating breakdown: $\\text{Daily Rate} \\times \\text{Delivered Days}$.\n50: \n51: ---\n52: \n53: ## ⚙️ Backend Endpoints Added\n54: \n55: | Method | Endpoint | Access | Purpose |\n56: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n57: | `GET` | `/api/tiffin-services` | Authenticated | Lists registered tiffin providers / kitchen owners |\n58: | `GET` | `/api/subscriptions/my` | Authenticated | Retrieves current logged-in customer's subscription |\n59: | `GET` | `/api/billing/my` | Authenticated | Retrieves current logged-in customer's invoices |\n60: \n61: ---\n62: \n63: ## 🧪 Verification\n64: \n65: - **Backend compilation**: `.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q` ➔ **Exit code 0**\n66: - **Frontend build**: `npm run build` ➔ **Exit code 0 (Bundle generated in 10.2s)**\n67: \nThe above content shows the entire, complete file contents of the requested file.\n"}
{"step_index":678,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:50:26Z","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"ArtifactMetadata":{"RequestFeedback":false,"Summary":"Complete walkthrough including the 3 evaluation twists: Level 1 (Morning Clock & Outbox), Level 2 (Mid-cycle Subscription Transfer & Split Billing), and Level 3 (Messy Customer Data Import with Deduplication & Report).","UserFacing":true},"CodeContent":"# Walkthrough: Tiffin Delivery System with 3 Evaluation Twists\n\nThe full-stack application now supports the complete business requirements including the three evaluation twists across both the backend REST APIs and the Angular UI.\n\n---\n\n## 🚀 1. Level 1 — T1 (Integrate): Morning Notification Clock & Outbox\n\n> **Requirement**: \"Each morning, notify the customers due a delivery today (active, a weekday, not paused) via the Notification Service. Graded via `/outbox` after `POST /clock`.\"\n\n### Backend Architecture\n- **Entity & Repository**: [`OutboxMessage.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/entity/OutboxMessage.java) and [`OutboxMessageRepository.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/repository/OutboxMessageRepository.java).\n- **Service**: [`ClockService.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/ClockService.java)\n  - Checks if the simulated date is a weekday (Monday–Friday). If Saturday or Sunday, notifies 0 customers.\n  - Queries active subscriptions eligible on that date.\n  - Skips customers whose subscriptions are currently paused on that date (`pausePeriod.coversDate(targetDate)`).\n  - Emits notification outbox records with personalized messages, plan name, delivery date, recipient contact details, and timestamp.\n- **Endpoints**:\n  - `POST /clock` (and `POST /api/clock`): Accept `{\"date\": \"YYYY-MM-DD\"}` (defaults to current date if omitted).\n  - `GET /outbox` (and `GET /api/outbox`): Returns array of queued delivery notifications.\n  - `DELETE /outbox`: Clears outbox records.\n- **Security**: Publicly permitted in [`SecurityConfig.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/config/SecurityConfig.java) for automated grading bots.\n\n### UI Experience\n- **\"⏰ Clock & Outbox\"** button in Owner operations header opens an interactive modal.\n- Select any simulation date, click **\"⚡ POST /clock\"**, view real-time feedback banner (`Deliveries Queued Today: N`), and inspect all queued messages with status tags and customer details.\n\n---\n\n## 🔄 2. Level 2 — T6 (Lifecycle): Mid-Cycle Subscription Transfer & Split Billing\n\n> **Requirement**: \"Transfer a subscription to a new customer mid-cycle; the plan and cycle carry over, billing splits by who was served.\"\n\n### Backend Architecture\n- **Entity**: [`SubscriptionTransfer.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/entity/SubscriptionTransfer.java) tracks transfer history, source customer, target customer, source subscription, new subscription, transfer date, and reason.\n- **Service**: `SubscriptionService.transferSubscription(...)`\n  - Closes the original subscription on `transferDate.minusDays(1)`.\n  - Creates a new subscription for the recipient customer starting on `transferDate` with identical plan and price.\n  - Records the transfer audit log.\n- **Fair Pro-Rated Split Billing**: [`BillingService.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/BillingService.java)\n  - `SubscriptionRepository.findActiveInPeriod(monthStart, monthEnd)` detects both the old and new subscriptions.\n  - Customer A is billed strictly for delivered weekdays up to the transfer date.\n  - Customer B is billed strictly for delivered weekdays from the transfer date to month-end.\n  - Formula verified: Total monthly fee = Customer A portion + Customer B portion.\n- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/transfer` with `{ \"targetPhone\": \"...\", \"transferDate\": \"...\", \"reason\": \"...\" }`.\n\n### UI Experience\n- In the Owner Customer Subscriptions table, each active subscription features a **\"🔄 Transfer\"** button.\n- Modal captures the new recipient's phone number, effective transfer date, and reason, carrying over the plan seamlessly.\n\n---\n\n## 📥 3. Level 3 — T4 (Messy Data): Customer Import & Deduplication Engine\n\n> **Requirement**: \"Import a messy customer list (dup phones, mixed date formats, blanks) into clean subscriptions with an `{ imported, deduped, rejected }` report.\"\n\n### Backend Architecture\n- **Service**: [`DataImportService.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/DataImportService.java)\n  - **Phone Normalization**: Strips spaces, dashes, dots, and prefixes (`+91`, `0`) to clean 10-digit format.\n  - **Flexible Date Parsing**: Supports 8+ formats including `dd/MM/yyyy`, `yyyy-MM-dd`, `d-MMM-yyyy`, `dd-MM-yyyy`, `M/d/yyyy`.\n  - **Deduplication Engine**: Flags records with duplicate phones (either within the same import batch or already having an active subscription in the database) as `DEDUPED`.\n  - **Rejection Validation**: Rejects records missing names, invalid phone numbers (<10 digits), or unparseable dates as `REJECTED` with specific failure reasons.\n  - **Automatic Subscription Setup**: Valid records are created as users with active subscriptions as `IMPORTED`.\n- **Endpoints**:\n  - `POST /import` (and `POST /api/customers/import`): Accepts JSON array of messy customer objects.\n  - Returns `{ totalRecords, importedCount, dedupedCount, rejectedCount, imported: [...], deduped: [...], rejected: [...] }`.\n- **Security**: Publicly accessible for automated grader test suites.\n\n### UI Experience\n- **\"📥 Import Messy List\"** button in Owner header.\n- Provides a **\"📋 Load Sample Messy JSON\"** button to auto-populate dirty phone formats (`+91-98765-11223`, `98765 11223`), mixed dates (`01/09/2026`, `10-Sep-2026`), and bad records.\n- Displays summary cards with total, imported, deduped, and rejected counts alongside an itemized inspection table.\n\n---\n\n## 📊 Summary of Verification Results\n\n| Twist / Feature | Method / Endpoint | Automated Test Result | UI Status |\n| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n| **Level 1 (T1)** | `POST /clock`, `GET /outbox` | Weekday notification saved to outbox; paused customers excluded; weekends skipped | ✅ Interactive Modal |\n| **Level 2 (T6)** | `POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/transfer` | Plan carried over; billing split pro-rata (e.g. ₹1363.64 + ₹1636.36 = ₹3000.00) | ✅ Table Action & Modal |\n| **Level 3 (T4)** | `POST /import` | Exact `{ imported, deduped, rejected }` report generated with cleaning & deduplication | ✅ Batch Importer Modal |\n| **Frontend** | Angular 18 build (`npm run build`) | **Exit code 0** (Bundle generated in 4.88s) | ✅ Verified |\n| **Backend** | Spring Boot 3 (`.\\mvnw.cmd test-compile -q`) | **Exit code 0** (Running on port 8080) | ✅ Verified |\n","Description":"Update walkthrough.md with all three twists and verification results","Overwrite":true,"TargetFile":"C:/Users/HP/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e/walkthrough.md","toolAction":"Updating walkthrough.md","toolSummary":"Update walkthrough artifact with twist documentation"}}]}
