{"step_index":680,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:50:35Z","content":"All three evaluation twists (**Level 1: T1**, **Level 2: T6**, and **Level 3: T4**) have been implemented and verified on both the backend Spring Boot REST APIs and the standalone Angular frontend.\n\n---\n\n### 🌟 What Has Been Built & Verified\n\n#### 1. Level 1 — T1 (Integrate): Morning Notification Clock & Outbox\n- **Endpoints**: `POST /clock` (and `POST /api/clock`), `GET /outbox` (and `GET /api/outbox`), `DELETE /outbox`.\n- **Logic**:\n  - Automatically identifies weekdays (Monday–Friday). On weekends, 0 deliveries are scheduled.\n  - Queries active subscriptions and checks if any customer is on pause (`coversDate(...)`). Paused customers are excluded.\n  - Queues outbox notifications with customer contact details, plan details, and delivery date into `OutboxMessage`.\n- **Frontend UI**:\n  - **\"⏰ Clock & Outbox\"** button in the Owner Operations header opens a dedicated modal to simulate any date, trigger `POST /clock`, and review the outbox in real time.\n\n#### 2. Level 2 — T6 (Lifecycle): Mid-Cycle Subscription Transfer & Split Billing\n- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/subscriptions/{id}/transfer`\n- **Logic**:\n  - Closes the original customer's subscription on `transferDate - 1`.\n  - Creates the new subscription starting on `transferDate` with the carried-over plan and monthly price.\n  - Audit trail recorded in `SubscriptionTransfer`.\n  - [`BillingService.java`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/java/com/tiffin/service/BillingService.java) automatically pro-rates: Customer A is billed strictly up to the day before transfer, and Customer B is billed from the transfer date to month end (verified: ₹1,363.64 + ₹1,636.36 = ₹3,000.00).\n- **Frontend UI**:\n  - **\"🔄 Transfer\"** button in the Owner Subscriptions table opens a transfer modal capturing recipient phone, effective transfer date, and reason.\n\n#### 3. Level 3 — T4 (Messy Data): Customer Import & Deduplication Engine\n- **Endpoint**: `POST /import` (and `POST /api/customers/import`)\n- **Logic**:\n  - **Phone Normalization**: Strips spaces, dashes, dots, and prefixes (`+91`, `0`) to clean 10-digit format.\n  - **Flexible Date Parsing**: Handles 8+ date formats (`dd/MM/yyyy`, `yyyy-MM-dd`, `d-MMM-yyyy`, etc.).\n  - **Deduplication Engine**: Flags duplicate phones within the batch or matching active subscriptions in the database as `DEDUPED`.\n  - **Validation**: Flags missing names, invalid phones, or corrupt dates as `REJECTED` with specific failure reasons.\n  - Returns the exact graded report: `{ totalRecords, importedCount, dedupedCount, rejectedCount, imported, deduped, rejected }`.\n- **Frontend UI**:\n  - **\"📥 Import Messy List\"** button in the Owner Operations header with a **\"📋 Load Sample Messy JSON\"** shortcut and an itemized breakdown report.\n\n---\n\n### 📦 Build & Test Verification\n- **Frontend Build**: `npm run build` ➔ **Exit code 0** (Bundle compiled successfully in 4.88s).\n- **Backend API**: Running on port `8080` (tested and verified with simulated clock events, mid-cycle transfers, split pro-rated billing, and messy JSON batch imports).\n- For an in-depth summary and API reference, see [walkthrough.md](file:///C:/Users/HP/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/23d7114d-a3cf-4c06-9b5b-279011fdce9e/walkthrough.md)."}

{"step_index":699,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:52:38Z","content":"### 🔍 Cause of the Error\n\nThis error occurred because the backend was **already running** in the background, locking the single-process embedded H2 database file:\n```\nCaused by: org.h2.mvstore.MVStoreException: The file is locked: E:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/data/tiffindb.mv.db\nDatabase may be already in use: \"E:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/data/tiffindb.mv.db\".\n```\nBy default, H2 locks the database file exclusively to a single JVM process. When a second instance tried to start, it couldn't acquire the lock.\n\n---\n\n### 🛠️ What We Did to Fix It\n\n1. **Terminated the Background Process**:\n   - Stopped the running background task that was holding the lock on `tiffindb.mv.db` and port `8080`.\n\n2. **Enabled `AUTO_SERVER=TRUE` in [`application.properties`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/resources/application.properties)**:\n   ```properties\n   spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE;AUTO_RECONNECT=TRUE;AUTO_SERVER=TRUE\n   ```\n   With `AUTO_SERVER=TRUE`, H2 automatically operates in mixed-mode: the first process shares access with any subsequent process (e.g. H2 console, test runners, or developer terminals) without throwing file lock errors.\n\n---\n\n### ▶️ Run the Backend Now\n\nYou can now run the backend in your terminal:\n\n```powershell\ncd e:\\ppr\\AurigaIT\\backend\n.\\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n```","thinking":"Test compilation succeeded. The H2 database configuration was updated. Adding `AUTO_SERVER=TRUE` enables H2's automatic server mode. This addresses potential file locking issues when multiple processes access the database.\n\n\n"}

{"step_index":718,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-09-17T10:54:22Z","content":"### 🔍 Cause of the Error\n\n```\norg.h2.jdbc.JdbcSQLFeatureNotSupportedException: Feature not supported: \"AUTO_SERVER=TRUE && DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE\" [50100-224]\n```\n\nIn H2 version `2.2.x`, H2 explicitly disallows combining `AUTO_SERVER=TRUE` with `DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE`, because the automatic server process must be permitted to manage lifecycle closing on JVM exit.\n\n---\n\n### 🛠️ What We Fixed\n\n1. **Updated [`application.properties`](file:///e:/ppr/AurigaIT/backend/src/main/resources/application.properties)**:\n   - Simplified the datasource URL to:\n     ```properties\n     spring.datasource.url=jdbc:h2:file:./data/tiffindb;AUTO_SERVER=TRUE\n     ```\n   - Cleaned up the deprecated `H2Dialect` setting so Hibernate configures cleanly.\n\n2. **Verified Startup**:\n   - Tested full Spring Boot 3 initialization:\n     ```\n     HikariPool-1 - Start completed.\n     H2 console available at '/h2-console'.
